Clinical Project Manager (CNS/Rare Disease) - Remote, US

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

As a Clinical Project Manager
at ICON, you will be responsible for leading and coordinate project activities, ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

What You Will Do

Your focus will be on coordinating project and program management delivery, resolving issues, and developing team capability.

Key Responsibilities Include

Developing and managing detailed clinical project plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation to ensure successful project delivery.
Leading cross-functional project teams, coordinating efforts to meet project objectives, and facilitating effective communication and collaboration.
Monitoring project progress, identifying potential risks and issues, and implementing strategies to address challenges and keep projects on track.
Engaging with stakeholders to manage expectations, provide updates, and ensure alignment with project goals and organizational objectives.
Preparing and presenting project reports, status updates, and performance metrics to senior management and other stakeholders.

Your Profile

You will have solid project and program management experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.

Required Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in life science, project management, business, or related fields
Minimum of 7 years of clinical research experience or proven competencies for this position and a minimum of 2 years of direct global clinical project management experience
Clinical Project management experience from CRO or Biotech company highly preferred
Proven track record of successfully managing clinical projects from inception to completion, with a focus on delivering results within scope, time, and budget constraints.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and manage stakeholder expectations.
CNS/Rare Disease clinical project management experience is required
Willingness to travel as required (approximately 30%)

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

Various annual leave entitlements
A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
Life assurance
Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Finance
jobs.description:
Innovation Starts With You

Propel your career at Belden, where innovation creates possibilities—for our people, our customers, and the communities we serve. We connect people, information, and ideas to solve the world’s most complex connectivity challenges, turning curiosity into meaningful impact. Here, you’ll take on work that challenges you, supports your growth, and empowers you to shape what’s next. You’ll collaborate with global teams, gain diverse perspectives, and contribute to solutions that extend beyond our business—creating value in the world around us.

Together, we are shaping the future of digitization and paving the way for the next generation of innovation.

Position Summary

Belden is seeking a Finance Project Manager to lead the tracking, reporting, and data analysis of productivity improvement projects across the organization. This role will serve as the central point of coordination between finance, operations, and business unit stakeholders to ensure productivity initiatives are accurately tracked, measured, and reported to leadership.

What You'll Do

Track and manage a portfolio of productivity projects, monitoring timelines, milestones, and financial impact from initiation through completion.
Pull, consolidate, and validate data from relevant systems and sources to support project tracking and financial reporting.
Partner with project owners and business unit leaders to gather status updates, savings estimates, and actuals.
Build and maintain dashboards, trackers, and reports that summarize project status, savings realized, and variance to forecast.
Analyze productivity data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities; flag discrepancies or underperforming projects to leadership.
Prepare monthly/quarterly reporting packages and presentations for finance leadership and executive stakeholders.
Ensure data integrity and consistency across reporting tools (e.g., Excel, SAP).
Support standardization of productivity tracking methodology and documentation across business units.
Assist in forecasting and budgeting processes related to productivity savings targets.
Identify process improvement opportunities within the tracking and reporting workflow itself.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field.
5+ years of experience in finance, FP&A, project management, or a related analytical role.
Strong proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data modeling)
Experience working with SAP & Oracle for data extraction and reporting.
Excellent organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
Effective communicator able to translate data into clear insights for non-finance stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments.
Prior experience tracking cost savings, productivity, or continuous improvement (e.g., Lean/Six Sigma) initiatives.
Experience with dashboard and data tools such as Power BI or Tableau

Key Competencies

Project management and organizational rigor
Data analysis and financial acumen
Cross-functional collaboration
Attention to detail and accuracy
Clear, concise communication with leadership

Let’s Create Possibilities Together.

Join a global community shaping the future of intelligent connectivity. At Belden, you’ll help push the boundaries of technology and write the next chapter of innovation, creating possibilities for your career, your future, and the world around you.

These statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.

Applicants can expect a base compensation range of $110,000 to $140,000, plus benefits and additional incentives based on the level of the role. This is the reasonable estimate that Belden believes it might pay for this job based on applicable circumstances at the time of posting. Belden may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range as permitted by law, and commensurate with the applicant’s experience, qualifications, and geographical location.

Belden also offers hybrid and remote work practices where feasible and provides employees with benefits that could include health/dental/vision, long term/short term disability, life insurance, HSA/FSA, matching retirement plans, paid vacation, parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, paid leave for volunteer work in your community, training opportunities, professional talent management and succession planning, corporate health well-being initiatives and a work culture which includes commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and sustainability!

jobs.description:
About The Company

Guidehouse is a leading global consulting firm dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and strategic insights to government agencies, commercial organizations, and nonprofit entities. With a commitment to excellence and integrity, Guidehouse specializes in a wide range of services including management consulting, technology advisory, risk management, and digital transformation. The company prides itself on fostering a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values diversity, continuous learning, and professional growth. Through its extensive expertise and client-centric approach, Guidehouse aims to help organizations navigate complex challenges and achieve their strategic objectives.

About The Role

The Senior Business Analyst supporting the federal Chief Information Officer (CIO) at Guidehouse plays a vital role in enhancing office operations and project delivery across various technology initiatives. This position involves leading the development of strategic plans, roadmaps, and project plans that facilitate complex technology integrations. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, providing insights and recommendations to prioritize projects, allocate resources, and establish realistic timelines. As a senior member of the team, you will manage multiple projects of varying scope and complexity, ensuring successful execution from initiation through closure. Your technical expertise will be instrumental in identifying project risks, dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement. Collaboration with agency leaders, vendors, and contracting teams is essential to support seamless project delivery and stakeholder satisfaction. Additionally, you will be responsible for managing data calls, preparing briefings for leadership, and owning key departmental initiatives aligned with the CIO’s strategic objectives.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, candidates must meet the following qualifications:

U.S. citizenship is a contractual requirement.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Federal or DoD "Public Trust" clearance, with approved adjudication prior to onboarding.
A minimum of eight (8) years of experience supporting technology projects, demonstrating a track record of successful project delivery.
Possession of PMP certification is highly preferred; however, candidates must demonstrate the ability to obtain it.
Proven success in delivering multiple technology initiatives and fostering trust with clients and stakeholders.
Experience managing technical projects, escalating risks, and supporting schedules and resource planning.
Knowledge of enterprise systems and deployment processes such as IT Service Management, Change Requests, and Business Analysis.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex system and project needs into actionable business strategies.

Responsibilities

The key responsibilities for this role include:

Supporting a federal CIO by enhancing operational efficiency and project execution within the office.
Leading the development and maintenance of strategic plans, project roadmaps, and detailed project plans to support complex technology initiatives.
Providing strategic insights to clients to help establish project priorities, allocate resources effectively, and adhere to established timelines.
Managing the end-to-end lifecycle of projects, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure, while serving as a senior business analyst.
Sourcing and evaluating customer requirements across multiple systems and stakeholder groups to ensure project alignment and success.
Tracking the delivery of key initiatives, enabling success through thorough analysis, coordination, and communication.
Using technical expertise to identify potential project risks, dependencies, and issues, escalating as needed to mitigate impacts.
Collaborating with agency leaders, vendors, and contracting teams to facilitate smooth project execution and stakeholder engagement.
Managing and monitoring data calls from internal and external stakeholders, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
Preparing and presenting briefings to client leadership to inform decision-making and project status updates.
Owning and executing additional key initiatives aligned with the department’s strategic objectives as directed by the CIO.

Benefits

Guidehouse offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the well-being and professional development of its employees. Benefits include:

Medical, prescription, dental, and vision insurance plans.
Personal and family sick leave, along with company-paid holidays.
Potential eligibility for a discretionary variable incentive bonus.
Parental leave and adoption assistance programs.
401(k) retirement savings plan with company matching.
Basic and supplemental life insurance options.
Health Savings Accounts, flexible spending accounts for dental, vision, and dependent care.
Short-term and long-term disability coverage.
Student loan repayment assistance programs.
Tuition reimbursement and opportunities for personal development and certifications.
Employee referral programs and participation in corporate-sponsored events and community outreach initiatives.
Emergency back-up childcare program and mobility stipends to support work-life balance.

Equal Opportunity

We welcome individuals of all backgrounds, including protected veterans, persons with disabilities, and others protected by law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws and ordinances. We are dedicated to ensuring fair hiring practices and providing reasonable accommodations to candidates throughout the recruitment process. Guidehouse values diversity, equity, and inclusion as integral to our success and organizational culture. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Be trusted to make great things happen.

You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We're proud to say it's thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise and knowledge. And when you join us, you'll be a part of this genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone's voice is valued and treated equally.

AtkinsRéalis Transportation Project Delivery Practice (PDP) is the centre of excellence for the delivery of major transportation infrastructure projects and combines the best in project management and design management to provide a full suite of services to clients in the public and private sectors. The team is responsible for delivery of design services across our markets of Rail and Transit, Highways and Local Transport, and lean out into other sectors including Defence and Nuclear. We have a wide client base including HS2, National Highways, Network Rail, Irish Rail, Local Authorities, as well as several Principal Contractors.

There is an exciting opening within the PDP Rail and Transit team for a Project Manager to help deliver our growing portfolio of railway infrastructure projects. This is a great opportunity to take ownership of projects from start to finish and grow your career in a dynamic and supportive environment.

With a home office in Bristol, London, Cardiff or Swindon,
this role requires flexibility to travel two to three days per week across the UK and Ireland to be involved in some of our most exciting flagship projects.

Your role

Project Delivery: Lead projects from feasibility and optioneering through to detailed design, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and to quality standards.
Team Leadership: Build, motivate, maintain, coach, guide, and develop teams.
Planning & Coordination: Work with resource managers to plan ahead and ensure the right skills are available. Align teams on scope, timelines, costs, risks, and interfaces.
Performance Monitoring: Track and report project progress against key targets including programme, quality, financials, and KPIs.
Governance and Commercial Management: Ensure compliance with company, client, and industry standards. Manage risks, opportunities, and contract changes throughout the project lifecycle.
Client Engagement: Act as the main point of contact for clients, building strong relationships and identifying opportunities for future work.
Win Work: Act as Bid Manager on selective pursuits, working with our Market teams to secure new projects.
Team Development and Community Contribution: Share best practices, mentor junior staff, and contribute to the wider project management community.

About You

You are likely to have several years of infrastructure delivery experience, gained within a consultancy environment or in applicable roles for client or contractor organisations.
Project/Engineering Management background with experience of the Heavy Rail or Light Rail/Mass Transit sector gained delivering work for clients such as Network Rail, HS2, Transport for London, Transport for Greater Manchester and Principal Contractors.
Experience of leading multi-disciplinary design teams (>£1m design fees) either as part of design & build contracts or for design development commissions.
Understanding of design delivery, assurance, and change control.
Ability to work constructively and collaboratively with clients and internal teams to ensure project objectives are met.
Understanding of various forms of contract, in particular NEC3 or 4 and/or bespoke forms, and experience of deploying them.
Professional membership and recognised level of Project Management competence (eg. MAPM, MICE, PMQ, or equivalent) - desirable.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About AtkinsRéalis

jobs.title: Senior Digital Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About The Role

6sense is hiring a Senior Digital Program Manager
to build and run the digital engagement engine for our Customer Success organization. This is a hybrid role: an expert-level Gainsight builder, program lead, and strategist. You will own the platform and, more importantly, You will own the platform and the quality of what gets built on it: the journeys, programs, and measurement that put CS strategy into action at scale. You are accountable for how they are built, for their accuracy, and for reporting on how they perform. Your primary focus will be to build and operate the digital programs that carry out CS strategy, report on where they are working and where customers are going unengaged, and recommend what to build next within CS priorities.

You will partner closely with CS Leadership, CS Operations, Marketing, Product, and Support. You are not a ticket-taker: you identify the gaps, propose the program, build it, launch it, and prove its impact.

What This Role Is – And Isn't

This role is for someone who has done this before and does not need a runway. We need a builder and program owner, not a resource waiting to be directed.

You move fast and ship. Journeys launch in weeks, not months. We do not wait for perfect requirements; we iterate.
You lead, not just execute. You do not wait for requests. You use data to find where customers are not being engaged, then bring a proposed program, a business case, and a plan.
You flag blockers immediately. Unclear or missing requirements are raised the same day, with a recommendation attached.
You own your backlog. You prioritize your own backlog and drive to resolution. We review outputs; we do not track status.
You know the difference between "I need input" and "I need permission." Judgment calls within scope get made. Questions that need business context get escalated quickly.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Program Strategy & Ownership

Own the strategy, roadmap, and calendar for CS digital programs across the customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
Design and launch strategic, segment-level programs and journeys, aligned to customer segmentation, health scoring, and CS coverage models.
Build the business case for each program: audience, objective, success metrics, content needs, and required resources. Prioritize the roadmap with CS Leadership.
Act as project and program lead for cross-functional digital initiatives, coordinating Marketing, Product, Support, Sales, and Enablement to deliver on time.
Pilot and evaluate new engagement channels and tactics (in-app, email, community, webinars, and others) and scale what works.

Digital Journey & Campaign Build

Design and build automated journeys in Gainsight, including conditional logic, multi-step triggers, and data-driven audiences.
Create, manage, and optimize email programs and in-app campaigns targeting customers at key lifecycle moments. Partner with Marketing and CS on messaging, and own campaign hygiene and governance.
Build and maintain audience segments, rules, and triggers for digital touchpoints; connect digital programs to CTAs and human-led plays so digital and CSM engagement work together.
A/B test content, timing, and cadence; report results and iterate.

Engagement Coverage & Gap Analysis

Track engagement: which customers, segments, and lifecycle stages are receiving touches, and which are not.
Identify and quantify gaps – unengaged accounts, stalled onboarding, low adoption, at-risk renewals with no digital or human outreach – and turn them into prioritized programs and recommendations.
Maintain a clear view of program progress against plan, and present findings and next steps to CS Leadership on a regular cadence.

Gainsight Platform Leader

Serve as the primary Gainsight Lead for Customer Success, owning building, data integrity, and platform health in regards to digital customer lifecycle.
Ensure Snowflake, Salesfoce, and other connectors data ingestion into Gainsight is usable for customer lifecycle programs
Document configurations, processes, and runbooks proactively.

Reporting, Analytics & Insights

Build and maintain dashboards and reports for CS Leadership
Track journey and program performance: reach, open and click rates, engagement, stage progression, product adoption, and influence on retention and expansion.
Provide regular, data-backed recommendations to improve program effectiveness and to inform coverage and resourcing decisions.

CS Ops & Leadership Partnership

Translate CS Leadership priorities and CS Ops workflows into programs and Gainsight builds quickly and with minimal hand-holding.
Participate in regular syncs with CS Ops and Leadership to gather requirements, share updates, and surface dependency gaps before they cause delays.
Enable CSMs to act on digital program outputs, and communicate program changes clearly.

Qualifications

Required

4–6+ years in Customer Success Operations, Digital/Scaled Customer Success, or lifecycle programs, including 3–5 years of hands-on Gainsight Building (or admin level type access).
Proven experience designing, building, and managing Journey Orchestrator programs and email campaigns from strategy through measurement.
Demonstrated program or project leadership: you have owned cross-functional initiatives and delivered measurable outcomes.
Strong understanding of the Gainsight data model – MDA, relationships, connectors, and Rules Engine.
Experience with Snowflake-to-Gainsight data ingestion, including connector setup, MDA mapping, and pipeline troubleshooting.
Proficiency with Salesforce integrations and how Gainsight syncs with SFDC, Snowflake, and other data providers.
Experience using data to identify engagement gaps and turn them into prioritized programs.
Working knowledge of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, and health scoring in a B2B SaaS environment.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver without oversight.
Track record of fast execution: you have built dashboards in a day and launched journeys in a week.
Strong written and verbal communication, with executive presence and the ability to document for technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have

Gainsight Admin certification.
Experience with health scoring model design and maintenance.
Hands-on experience with Pendo, including building in-app guides and messaging, defining behavioral segments, analyzing product usage and adoption, and using insights to trigger targeted digital CS journeys
Experience using Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and Workato to accelerate content creation, automate workflows, and scale digital CS programs.
Experience with lifecycle marketing, in-app messaging, or digital customer success programs at scale.
Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools; familiarity with SQL.
Experience in a commercial or mid-market CS motion supporting a large, digitally served customer base.

What Success Looks Like

First 15 days:
The Gainsight digital programs have been reviewed and the backlog is prioritized and agreed with CS Ops and CS Leadership. An initial engagement coverage baseline for the commercial book shows where customers are and are not being reached. Quick-win deliverables are shipped (dashboards, segments, reports), and at least one digital journey is live in production.

Within 30 days:
Existing journeys have been updated and new programs are being launched. Full program and campaign calendar is underway. A strategic program roadmap for the Commercial book is reviewed and approved by CS Leadership. Performance and gap reporting is in place and stakeholders are reviewing results.

Within 45 days:
Engagement gaps prioritized by CS Leadership have programs in market, with measurable movement in reach and engagement. A recurring cadence for program review and gap reporting is established, and digital and CSM-led motions are connected through CTAs and plays.

Base Salary Range: $92,812.50 - $136,125.00. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO).

jobs.title: Hardware Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About The Role

We are looking for a Hardware Technical Program Manager to drive our hardware products from concept through production across the automotive, trucking, defense, construction, mining, and agriculture industries. This role owns end-to-end program management for complex hardware systems — spanning electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and system architecture — ensuring our hardware ships on schedule, at quality, and within cost.

At Applied Intuition, You Will

Own and drive the product development process (PDP) for hardware programs, from early concept and architecture through qualification and production launch
Manage multiple concurrent hardware programs, each spanning cross-functional teams across electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, firmware, and system integration
Define program scope, schedules, and milestones, and hold cross-functional teams accountable to committed timelines, quality bars, and cost targets
Identify technical risks and gaps early, and drive mitigation plans in close partnership with engineering leads
Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, and contract manufacturing partners to ensure components and subsystems are delivered on time and meet quality requirements
Serve as the operational backbone of each hardware program — running design reviews, tracking action items, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks
Partner with software and systems teams to align hardware and software integration milestones
Communicate program status, risks, and decisions clearly to engineering leadership and stakeholders

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or related field) or equivalent
7+ years of experience in hardware technical program management, with a demonstrated track record of shipping hardware products to production
Experience across multiple hardware product lines or industries (e.g., consumer electronics, automotive, defense, construction, mining, or agriculture)
Deep understanding of the hardware product development process (PDP), including design, prototyping, verification/validation, and manufacturing ramp
Experience managing multiple complex, concurrent hardware programs with competing priorities and tight timelines
Strong technical fluency across electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and system architecture — enough to engage deeply in technical trade-off discussions
Experience working with contract manufacturers, component vendors, and supply chain partners
Excellent organizational and communication skills, with a high bar for documentation and program hygiene

Nice To Have

Experience shipping hardware in automotive, trucking, defense, construction, mining, or agriculture industries
Experience with autonomous systems, robotics, or sensing platforms (LiDAR, Radar, Cameras)
Familiarity with PLM/material tracking systems and BOM management
Experience managing specialty build partners, prototype vehicle upfits, or Tier-1/OEM integration programs

Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

jobs.title: IT/OT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a seasoned IT/OT Project Manager to work from an offshore location, driving the end-to-end planning, governance, and delivery of combined Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) initiatives for manufacturing, retail, and banking/financial services clients. The ideal candidate is a PRINCE2-certified practitioner with a strong background in Infrastructure, cloud migration/transformation, and production support service delivery, who can bridge traditional IT project management discipline with OT/ICS domain awareness, drive multi-tower (L1–L3) support governance, and partner with Sales, Partner/OEM, and cross-functional IT&D/Cyber/Supply teams to deliver outcomes within scope, effort, and budget.

Key Responsibilities

IT/OT Project & Program Delivery

Lead end-to-end delivery of IT/OT projects (fit-gap assessments, infrastructure upgrades, remediation, migrations, cybersecurity hardening) across manufacturing sites and enterprise environments, ensuring scope, schedule, budget, and quality targets are met.
Develop and maintain project charters, project plans, RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), and governance cadence for each engagement, in line with PRINCE2 methodology.
Drive site/factory fit-gap analysis, BOM and LLD sign-offs, and cutover/rollback planning in collaboration with partner teams, IT&D platform teams, Cyber, and Supply/Operations teams.
Coordinate day-to-day activities of offshore/onshore engineers, architects, and third-party vendors/OEMs, tracking milestones, dependencies, and resource allocation.

Infrastructure, Cloud & OT/ICS Governance

Lead Infrastructure projects, data center decommissioning, and cloud migration/transformation initiatives (AWS, Azure) across on-prem and hybrid environments.
Govern OT High-Level and Low-Level Design (HLD/LLD) activities in alignment with ISA-95, the Purdue Model, and IEC 62443 standards, overseeing network segmentation and OT/IT convergence activities.
Oversee EOL hardware retirement, OS/software upgrades, network device refresh, and server migration programs, performing impact analysis to ensure minimal disruption to BAU operations.
Support vulnerability management, patch governance (including Linux/database patching compliance), and remediation planning in coordination with security SMEs.

Service Delivery & Production Support Management

Own service delivery of multi-tower (L1–L3) support teams spanning Infrastructure support, Help Desk, Desk-side support, Digital Workplace services, and Application support for Retail and Banking/Financial customers.
Manage service delivery of support teams as per contractual terms (SLAs/KPIs), leading Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes and chairing major incident bridges to resolution.
Drive Service Transition and Service Operations activities, including onboarding of new services, resource transition planning, and knowledge/documentation handover for steady-state support.
Lead Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives – automation, cross-skilling, shift-left/shift-right, and LEAN methodologies – to improve NPS/CSAT scores and optimize team sizing and margins.

Stakeholder, Vendor & Financial Management

Act as the primary point of contact for client program/project stakeholders, IT&D leadership, and business sponsors, providing regular status reports on progress, risks, and financials.
Partner with Sales teams to define solutions, resource requirements, transformation opportunities, and productivity improvement ideas for Infrastructure managed services and IT/OT deals.
Manage vendor/OEM/partner relationships and SDM reviews, ensuring SLA adherence and driving corrective action plans for service quality gaps.
Own budget management for the engagement – estimates, forecasts, change requests, and cost-optimization opportunities (e.g., license optimization, device refresh) – through the appropriate SOW/SO governance process.

Required Qualifications & Experience

PRINCE2 Foundation and Practitioner certified, with 15+ years of managerial experience delivering projects within defined scope, effort, and budget.
24+ years of overall IT experience, including 15+ years of onshore experience at customer locations (e.g., UK, Europe, APAC), and proven experience managing offshore delivery teams.
Strong experience leading Production Support teams for Financial and Retail customers, and improving margins through continuous service improvement and service delivery excellence.
Demonstrated experience managing Infrastructure projects, cloud migration, and transformation programs in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Experience managing service delivery of support teams (up to 80+ headcount) as per contractual terms, spanning Infrastructure support, Help Desk, Desk-side support, Digital Workplace, and Application support.
Experience partnering with Sales teams on solutioning, resourcing, and transformation opportunities for Infrastructure managed services deals.
Working knowledge of OT/ICS technologies and concepts (SCADA, DCS, PLC, HMI, MES, Purdue Model/ISA-95) and OT cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443, NIST) is highly desirable for IT/OT convergence engagements.
Excellent stakeholder management, vendor management, and people management skills, with strong verbal/written communication and a fast learner's approach to new tools and technologies.

Areas of Expertise

Infrastructure Management & Project Management
Stakeholder Management & Vendor Management
Service Transition, Service Operations & Continual Service Improvement
Incident Management, Problem Management & Change Management
Budget Management & People Management

Preferred Skills & Tools

Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure (Azure Stack, AzureAD); familiarity with cloud/infrastructure migration projects impacting IT/OT environments.
Databases & OS: Oracle, MSSQL, MySQL, DB2; Red Hat Linux, HP-UX, IBM AIX, Windows.
EUC & Collaboration Tools: Intune, O365 suite, OKTA, Citrix, Teams, WebEx, Zoom.
Security & Monitoring Tools: Zscaler, Proofpoint, McAfee, Tenable, SolarWinds, SCOM.
Ticketing & Knowledge Management: ServiceNow, JIRA, BMC Remedy, Confluence.
Service Management Practices: ITIL, Shift Left/Shift Right, LEAN/Six Sigma project management.
Experience with manufacturing/industrial, Retail, and Banking/Financial clients, and cross-border/global delivery models (UK, Europe, APAC).
Ability to manage multiple concurrent IT/OT projects/workstreams and mentor junior project coordinators and support engineers.

Certifications (Preferred)

PRINCE2 Foundation and Practitioner Certificate in Project Management (or PMP equivalent).
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) and Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900), or equivalent cloud certifications.
ITIL Foundation certification is an added advantage.

Work Environment

This is primarily an offshore-based role with standard office working hours aligned to overlap with onsite/client teams across time zones (e.g., UK, Europe, APAC); occasional extended hours may be required to support cutover windows, go-lives, or major incident response. Limited travel to customer sites may be required on a need basis, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement with the client.

jobs.description:
Brio Water Technology, a Home Organizers, Inc. company,
is a market leading water products brand that has helped millions stay hydrated through its unique and innovative product line. We offer full home water solutions designed to elevate the way people hydrate, combining sophisticated technology with modern, top tier design to deliver exceptional performance, customer satisfaction, and enhanced functionality.

Home Organizers, Inc.
is the parent organization behind a portfolio of well-known home products and services brands, including Closet World, Closets by Design, Brio Water Technology, and others. With decades of experience supporting innovation, design, manufacturing, and customer focused solutions, Home Organizers helps its brands deliver high quality products and services that improve everyday living for households across the country.

About the role

As part of Home Organizers, Inc., Brio Water Technology is looking for a Program Manager, Technology to build the program governance, standards, and processes that do not yet exist within our technology organization. This is a foundational, hands-on role for someone who walks into ambiguity and sees opportunity rather than a problem.

This role is deliberately two jobs in one. As the business analyst, you define the problem, outline the scope, and make sure the solution fits what the business actually needs. As the program manager, you own the budget, hold the timeline, and deliver through the team. We are looking for someone who does both, and who knows which one a given moment calls for.

The right person starts with people, not plans: they talk to our internal customers, learn their pain points, understand the current state, and use what they learn to design the processes and procedures we do not yet have. They are proactive by default. Wherever there is a compliance concern, an undocumented procedure, or a process with no owner, they step in, create clarity, and carry it until a permanent owner is in place. They do not wait to be assigned work; they find the gaps, close them, and hand them off.

This person arrives with Agile coaching experience already in hand. As our teams mature and grow, they will take on Scrum Master duties and coach teams of varying size and experience. All of it requires influence without authority, and comfort operating alongside senior leaders and executives who hold deep institutional knowledge of how our systems actually behave.

Objectives of the role

Establish the program governance, standards, and compliance foundation our technology organization does not yet have, in close partnership with internal stakeholders.
Take ownership of gaps: compliance concerns, undocumented procedures, and unowned processes, creating clarity and carrying them until a permanent owner is in place.
Lead cross-functional technology programs end to end, from problem definition and requirements through delivery, coordinating teams and vendors outside your direct management chain.
Take on the role of Scrum Master, Agile Coach, and business analyst for one or more teams as our organization matures.

What you'll do

Strategic planning.
Define the roadmap, goals, and long-term vision for assigned programs, and sequence the work so near-term delivery builds toward the target state.
Business analysis.
Define the problem before the solution is chosen. Elicit and document requirements, map current and future state, set scope, and write acceptance criteria, confirming that what gets built fits what the business actually needs.
Stakeholder communication.
Serve as the primary bridge between project teams, executives, and external partners. Run working sessions, keep everyone current on status, risks, and decisions, and work directly with stakeholders up to the executive level and with subject matter experts who hold deep institutional knowledge of how our systems behave.
Change management and adoption.
Many of our teams have worked in the same systems, using the same processes, for a very long time. Adoption here is earned, not announced. Communicate change early and often, brief the leadership of each area before rollout so their questions are answered ahead of go-live, and provide the training and hands-on support people need to work confidently in the new process. Success is measured by adoption, not by the go-live date.
Program delivery.
Lead cross-functional technology programs end to end: system implementations, migrations, and infrastructure initiatives, coordinating teams outside your direct management chain, including external vendors, internal business stakeholders, and technical SMEs.
Cross-project coordination.
Manage interdependencies across concurrent projects, surface scheduling and resource conflicts early, and drive them to resolution.
Budget oversight.
Allocate resources, forecast expenses, and own budget adherence and variance tracking for assigned programs, including vendor software licensing, capital expenses for infrastructure upgrades, and cloud costs.
Risk management.
Identify roadblocks and risks early and implement corrective action. Maintain the risk register, change control process, policies and procedures, and audit-ready documentation.
Governance and gap ownership.
Stand up program governance where none exists today. Proactively identify compliance concerns, undocumented procedures, and processes without a clear owner; create interim structure, carry ownership, and hand off to permanent owners once established.
Agile leadership.
Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Agile teams, coaching teams of varying size and maturity as the organization scales.

Qualifications

3-5 years of program or project management experience, including managing individual program or project budgets between $250,000 and $1,000,000.
Cross-functional IT program delivery: has led system implementations, migrations, or infrastructure programs end to end, across teams they did not manage, including teams that spanned external vendors and internal SMEs.
Compliance and governance experience: has operated inside an audited or regulated environment (for example SOX, HIPAA, PCI, or SOC 2) and can re-create the artifacts it runs on: risk register, change control process, policies and procedures, and audit evidence. Prior authorship of these artifacts is not required; applied familiarity is.
Business analysis and business partner engagement: has gathered and documented requirements, run working sessions, and translated business needs into technical scope, working directly with stakeholders up to the executive level.
Hands-on Agile delivery experience and demonstrated Agile coaching experience, with the ability to serve as Scrum Master for one or more teams as the organization grows.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, current and in good standing.

Preferred Skills

Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).
Familiarity with formal change-management methodologies and stakeholder-management practices.

Think about the last time you tried to book a tennis court. Or sign your kid up for a swim lesson. Or find an open rec league that actually fits your schedule. You probably ended up on a website that looked like it was built in 2003 — or even worse, filled out a piece of paper.

We're a small team with firepower. Our founders were among the first few hundred at Uber, then led teams at The Athletic and MasterClass. The rest of the team combines builders from Google, Microsoft, Strava, Hipcamp, and Airbnb.

You will primarily be responsible for managing everything it takes to make our largest and most complex enterprise-size city partners a success. This includes joining sales pursuits for enterprise clients as our implementation and product expert, leading implementations, and managing relationships with senior city officials. You will also act as a voice internally within the company advocating for the product and operational needs of our largest and most complex customers.

This is a role for the client operations “athlete”, a voracious learner that wants exposure to all aspects of our B2B SaaS business and is relentlessly resourceful in achieving their goals. You should have experience managing senior clients and comfortable driving results across long term and complex projects. This is a strategic role and we will give you both the freedom and responsibility to become the domain expert trusted to make the right calls. However, this is also a hands-on early stage role where strategic insight comes from putting in the execution work yourself.

What You’ll Own

Onboard, retain, and grow customer accounts. You’ll lead the onboarding of new cities, manage relationships with existing partners, and strengthen customers’ engagements with Rec through renewals and expansion.
Own the customer relationship. You’ll own the customer relationship with cities, serving as a trusted advisor and partner to executive and senior leadership across various functions.
Build the customer success processes and playbook. Set the standard for an excellent customer experience and build the playbooks and processes to support this experience for your customers.
Synthesize, prioritize, and share learnings cross-functionally to shape product and business decisions. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners, especially product and sales, to distill learnings from your experience with cities, clearly synthesize and prioritize those learnings, and work with internal stakeholders to translate them into targeted improvements. You’ll directly shape the product development and sales targeting processes.

Who You Are

3-6 years working in Customer Success at a tech company or startup, at a top consulting firm or finance firm, or a combination of both.
2+ years experience managing clients at the enterprise level. Either large corporate or government clients
You have strong client-services experience. You’re cool under pressure in front of senior client stakeholders and know how to manage key relationships
You are a strong communicator. You can crisply communicate actionable data-driven insights and pitch tailored solutions to solve customers’ problems
You are a strategic problem solver. You can break down ambiguous problems and apply a first principles approach to solving them
You have exceptional project management skills. You can juggle multiple complex projects in flight and can reprioritize quickly
You have an entrepreneurial spirit and a high degree of drive, energy, and passion for creating and managing world-class operational processes
You are scrappy and resourceful. When something needs to get done, you always find a way to make it happen.

Our Values

Be Relentless. Move fast. Own it. Ship real value early and often.
Win Together. Speak up, go beyond the boundaries of your role. That's how we win.
Take Pride. Treat this like it’s yours—because it is.

Pay & Benefits

Benefits: Flexible PTO, top-tier health/dental/vision, and a 401(k) plan to support your future.

jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager (SaaS/Fintech)
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At Emburse, you’ll not just imagine the future – you’ll build it. As a leader in expense intelligence, we are creating a future where technology drives business value and inspires extraordinary results. Our AI-powered platform helps organizations modernize financial operations, increase visibility, and optimize spend across the enterprise.

The Implementation Project Manager plays a pivotal role in delivering seamless software activations and configurations for new and expanding enterprise clients. Acting as the functional and technical expert, you will lead clients through the end-to-end implementation lifecycle—from analyzing sales orders and gathering requirements to final software deployment and client handoff. You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, designing tailored software configurations that position clients for long-term operational success.

In this role, you will take full ownership of project scoping, timeline management, and cross-functional risk mitigation. You will meticulously review initial sales details to spot potential risks before kickoff, ensure all deliverables align with customer expectations, and maintain proactive, clear communication with both internal and external stakeholders. Leveraging both user-interface settings and back-end databases, scripts, and administrative tools, you will build and validate solutions that modernize our clients’ expense operations while keeping projects on schedule and within scope.

Please note we are not able to offer sponsorship now OR in the future

What you will Do:

Enterprise Client Onboarding: Lead end-to-end software implementations for large, enterprise-market clients (CER), taking primary ownership of high-revenue, complex, and strategic projects.
Requirements & Discovery: Facilitate client kick-offs, requirement-gathering sessions, and discovery meetings to translate business needs into tailored software capabilities.
System Configuration & Setup: Configure Emburse software according to project scope using user-interface settings, back-end configurations, and administrative tools to meet client requirements.
Mentorship & Team Leadership: Serve as a mentor, trainer, and functional resource for Implementation Specialists, guiding team members on best practices and technical onboarding.
Escalation Point: Act as the primary escalation contact for internal team members regarding product, process, and complex technical or troubleshooting questions.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Customer Success, Development, and Product teams to align on client needs, manage technical escalations, and execute seamless handoffs.
Process & Efficiency Improvements: Help develop and update core implementation workflows, providing guidance and feedback to refine internal tools, reduce turnaround times, and boost efficiency.
Project & Scope Management: Track milestones, manage deliverables, and handle multiple concurrent implementations within workload expectations while proactively mitigating risks.
Stakeholder Communication: Deliver exceptional, consultative customer service and maintain clear, regular status updates with client-side and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Product Expertise: Maintain advanced technical knowledge of Emburse solutions through continuous learning, testing, and collaboration to guide clients toward optimal long-term system usage.

What you will Bring:

5+ years of project management experience in a software delivery organization, including active involvement or leadership within a PMO environment.
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is highly desirable.
Strong understanding of corporate accounting systems, financial practices, and industry terminology relevant to expense and financial operations.
Hands-on mastery of the end-to-end project lifecycle, with a proven ability to manage complex, enterprise-level implementations with minimal oversight.
Exceptional customer-handling skills with demonstrated success navigating complex client escalations, resolving concerns, and exercising influence with external stakeholders.
Skill in analyzing business data to understand client operations, identify core requirements, and deliver actionable, high-value configuration insights.
Strong ability to see the "big picture," evaluate workflows, and execute efficient, scalable implementation processes across projects.
Excellent business writing and verbal communication skills, with fluency in articulating the value of structured project management practices to clients and internal teams.

Finance is changing—and at Emburse, we’re leading the way. Our AI-powered solutions help organizations eliminate inefficiencies, gain real-time visibility, and optimize spend—so they can focus on what’s next, not what’s slowing them down.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About The Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.

This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.

What You'll Do

Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.
Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.
Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders.
Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.
Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.
Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.
Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.
Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

What You Bring

Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.
Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.
Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.
Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.
Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.
A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

Bonus Points

Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments
Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards
Experience working with platform or API products
Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)
Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ at Kungsgatan 12-14 in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.

How To Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
Technical interview with some of our Engineering team
Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads
Home case and presentation at our office - Join us in the Stockholm office for a lunch, a presentation and som pair programming to experience our our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Benefits

Competitive salary & company stock options
30 days/year of paid vacation
5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives
Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents
Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
Mental health support through our partner Mindler
Pension program
Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.

We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

The Strategic Program Manager will lead high-impact growth and transformation programs across Advanced Services, turning strategic priorities into coordinated, measurable execution.

Working across Sales, Delivery, Portfolio, Finance and other Everpure organizations, the role will establish and run programs designed to accelerate services growth, customer adoption and organizational transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Growth Programs — Design, launch and manage programs that accelerate adoption, pipeline, bookings and revenue growth, including incentive-led and customer adoption initiatives.
Program Strategy & Execution — Translate strategic priorities into structured programs with clear objectives, work streams, milestones, ownership and measurable outcomes.
Acquisition & Organizational Integration — Lead Services integration activities associated with acquisitions, new technologies or organizational changes, coordinating capabilities, processes, people and GTM readiness.
Cross-functional Leadership — Coordinate stakeholders across Advanced Services, Sales, Portfolio, Product, Finance and Operations to drive execution without relying on direct authority.
Commercial & Performance Management — Establish business cases, success measures and reporting to understand program adoption, investment effectiveness and commercial impact.
GTM & Field Activation — Partner with Services Sales and Enablement to translate programs into practical field motions, communications, incentives and supporting assets.
Continuous Improvement — Use performance data and field/customer feedback to evolve programs, resolve barriers and determine when initiatives should scale, change or conclude.
Executive Communication — Provide clear updates on progress, risks, decisions and business impact to senior leadership.

What You Bring

Strong experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through execution.
Commercial mindset with an understanding of how programs drive adoption, pipeline, bookings and revenue growth.
Ability to turn ambiguous strategic priorities into clear plans, work streams, ownership and measurable outcomes.
Strong stakeholder leadership across Sales, Delivery, Portfolio, Finance and other business functions.
Experience influencing and driving execution across teams without direct authority.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders while remaining close to execution.
Data-driven approach to measuring performance, identifying barriers and adapting programs based on results.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and taking ownership of new or evolving strategic priorities.

What Success Looks Like

Strategic priorities are translated into well-defined programs with clear ownership, execution plans and measurable outcomes.
Growth programs demonstrate tangible impact on customer adoption, pipeline, bookings and revenue.
New capabilities, acquisitions and organizational changes are successfully integrated into Advanced Services.
Cross-functional stakeholders are aligned around common objectives, responsibilities and execution.
Program performance is visible through clear metrics, reporting and executive communication.
Successful initiatives are scaled and embedded into the business, while programs that are not delivering expected outcomes are adapted or concluded.
Advanced Services is better positioned to execute against Everpure's strategic growth priorities.

$146,000—$219,000 USD

What You Can Expect From Us

Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

jobs.title: Competitive Intelligence Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Competitive Intelligence (CI) Program Manager keeps iCIMS one step ahead of the competition. You’ll run the day-to-day engine of our CI program — collecting, synthesizing, and distributing competitive and market intelligence so Sales, Product, and Marketing can make faster, sharper decisions.

You’ll build that engine AI-first. We expect you to use generative AI, agents, and automation to monitor the market continuously, turn raw signals into insight in hours instead of weeks, and scale CI well beyond what one person could do manually. You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, Labs, Decision Support, and senior leadership, and your work will inform pricing, product strategy, sales tactics, corporate development, and marketing campaigns.

This is a high-visibility role for a curious, tech-forward self-starter who doesn’t wait to be asked — someone who spots a competitor’s move first, knows what it means for ICIMS, and gets the answer to the right people before the question comes up.

About Us

WWC Global, an operating firm of Command Holdings, is seeking a Vendor Threat Mitigation (VTM) Program Analyst to support the J45 within Indo-Pacific Command (INDOPACOM).

This position provides critical Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) and Vendor Threat Mitigation (VTM) planning, coordination, and intelligence-integration. The role ensures the security and resilience of the theater supply chain by identifying, assessing, and mitigating vendor-related risks—including foreign ownership, control, or influence (FOCI), cyber vulnerabilities, and adversarial exploitation—across the Area of Responsibility (AOR). The role is highly dynamic and adaptive to command priorities; requiring an experienced professional who can operate independently with minimal guidance.

Key Responsibilities May Include But Are Not Limited To

Conducting rigorous supply chain illuminations and vendor threat assessments to identify FOCI, cyber vulnerabilities, and adversarial influence risks within the AOR, ensuring mission requirements are protected from compromised suppliers.
Developing and implementing theater-specific VTM mitigation strategies and risk response plans, ensuring alignment with DoD security protocols and mission-critical function protection.
Supporting VTM planning for Tier 1 and Tier 2 Exercises (e.g., Balikatan, Cobra Gold), ensuring theater supply chains are modeled, stress-tested against subversion, and assessed during major training events.
Synchronizing vendor threat intelligence and mitigation strategies with USFK, USFJ, SOCPAC, and regional Service Components. Coordinating with DCSA, DLA, and USTRANSCOM to ensure a unified theater defense.
Serve as a subject matter expert for VTM policy and governance. Draft formal staff products (EXSUMs, Info Papers) and deliver executive-level briefings to General/Flag Officers (GO/FO) regarding theater supply chain vulnerabilities.
Demonstrating a deep understanding of, and the ability to apply, Joint Publications, Directives and Instructions with the associated policies that support theater distribution security and vendor threat mitigation. Example policies/instructions include: DoDD 5000.01 (Defense Acquisition System), DoDD 5240.02 (Counterintelligence), DoDI 5200.44 (Protection of Mission Critical Functions), DoDI 4140.01 (DoD Supply Chain Materiel Management), DoDI 5000.90 (Cybersecurity for Acquisition Decision Authorities and Program Managers), JP 4-0/JP4-01 (Joint Logistics and the Joint Deployment and Distribution Enterprise (JDDE), JP 4-10 (Operational Contract Support), JP 2-0/ JP 3-0 (Joint Intelligence and Joint Operations integration for threat-informed logistics), NDAA Compliance.

The role is assigned to the Multinational Logistics Branch, Plans & Exercise Division (J45) focuses on optimizing theater-level maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) capabilities, strengthening bilateral/multilateral logistics partnerships, and integrating logistics posture into the broader Theater Campaign Plan (TCP), Theater Posture Plan (TPP) and Theater Security Cooperation Program (TSCP).

Serving as a key contractor supporting USPACOM sustainment resiliency objectives.
Conducting high-level logistics capability assessments, facilitating partner engagements and drafting bilateral agreements.
Integrating regional Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) initiatives into major joint operations, security cooperation activities, and respective theater defense plans.
Collaborating across multi=echelon Joint Logistics Enterprise (JLEnt) organizations and foreign military counterparts.
Operationalizing the DoD Regional Sustainment Framework (RSF) strategy within the USPACOM Area of Responsibility (AOR).

Als Fachexperte (w/m/d) bist du als Teil des ISMS-Teams verantwortlich für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystems und hilfst du uns dabei, die Einhaltung einer Vielzahl von internen und externen Vorgaben und Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Dabei fungierst du auch als Schnittstelle zu GRC, technischer IT-Sicherheit und allen weiteren Fachbereichen.

Bei uns ist Sicherheit Teil unseres Markenkerns und nicht nur bloße Kostenstelle. Mit deiner Erfahrung schützt du Deutschlands einzige souveräne Azure Cloud und leistest damit einen wertvollen Beitrag zur Digitalisierung unseres Landes.

Wenn du dein Fachwissen einsetzen möchtest, um an vorderster Front mit einem kompetenten Team eine vielschichtige Angriffsfläche zu analysieren und gegen ein breites Spektrum an fortgeschrittenen Angreifern abzusichern, bewirb dich bei uns.

Was Du Tun Wirst

Implementierung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystems (ISMS) u. a. nach ISO/IEC 27001, IT-Grundschutz und BSI C5 im Rahmen unserer Sicherheits-, Zertifizierungs- und Compliancestrategie
Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher und regulatorischer Anforderungen
Erstellung und Überwachung von Informationssicherheitsrichtlinien und -verfahren
Identifikation und Bewertung von Sicherheitsrisiken und Unterstützung der Fachbereiche bei der Umsetzung von Maßnahmen
Vorbereitung von internen und externen Audits
Erstellung von Dokumentation zum Nachweis von Kontrollen im ISMS
Zusammenarbeit mit Fachexperten der Delos Cloud zur Identifikation und Implementierung von Sicherheitsmaßnahmen
Zusammenarbeit mit externen Stakeholdern u.a. aus Bund und Ländern sowie Microsoft und SAP zur Stärkung der Security sowie Compliance Posture der Delos Cloud
Vorbereitung und Übermittlung von Reports und Meldungen an das Senior Management, regulatorische Behörden und weitere Stakeholder

Was Du Mitbringst

Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich Informationssicherheit, idealerweise in einer ähnlichen Position
Erfahrung mit gängigen Standards in der Informationssicherheit, insb. ISO/IEC 27001
Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen und der Definition von Sicherheitsmaßnahmen
Optionale Zertifikate (z. B. CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer)
Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise
Stark ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Teamfähigkeit
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

#DelosCloud

Skills used in this role: Agentic AI Day-to-Day Practice, AI Adoption Capability, AI Output Quality Assurance, Context Engineering, AI-Assisted Automation and Prototyping, Learning Agility, Collaboration, Complex Problem Solving, Creative Thinking, Effective Communication, Certified Compliance Specialist, Information Security Audits, Audit Working Papers, Control Deficiency Management, Audit Risk

Wir gewinnen durch Inklusion

Delos’ Kultur der Inklusion, der Fokus auf Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden sowie flexible Arbeitsmodelle stellen sicher, dass sich alle – unabhängig vom Hintergrund – einbezogen fühlt und ihr Bestes geben können.

Bei Delos sind wir überzeugt davon, dass uns die einzigartigen Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften, die jede Person mitbringt, stärker machen. Deshalb investieren wir in die Menschen bei Delos, um Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und allen zu helfen, ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

Unser Ziel ist es, alle Talente zu fördern und eine bessere Welt zu schaffen.

Your opportunity

Support the accurate and timely processing of the full trade lifecycle across multiple asset classes. The role focuses on day‑to‑day operational execution, issue resolution, and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to ensure trades are processed in line with operational controls, policies, and regulatory requirements.

The Trade Operations Analyst contributes across Trade Affirmation & Capture, Settlement & Cashflows, and Listed Trade Operations, with opportunities to gain exposure to more complex products and operational initiatives over time.

Trade Lifecycle Processing

Issue Resolution & Controls

Maintain strong attention to data quality, reconciliations, and operational controls

Build effective working relationships within Operations, and Front Office, Technology, and external counterparties

Identify process inefficiencies or recurring issues and raise improvement ideas to senior team members

Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, enabling clear and effective interactions with stakeholders at all levels

The Pharmacy Operations Analyst, under general direction, serves as the primary analytic resource for patient care. The individual is responsible for working collaboratively with clinical and operational department managers and directors to support the monitoring and analysis of all financial, clinical, quality, and operational metrics in all patient care areas. Additionally, the Operations Analyst provides analytical expertise to end-users with the overall objective of enhancing performance. The Operations Analyst position also includes collection of information, preparation, and dissemination of frequent periodic reports critical to the organization’s operations. The position supports or leads the creation and distribution of internal and external nursing dashboards and other trending tools.
