Business and Data Knowledge: Understand the financial, clinical, quality and operational environment at NM. Possesses an ability to collect, organize and report on data as it pertains to the business and data processes at NM and the operational characteristics of the various departments. Exemplifies the effective use of information and systems to report on and improve patient care.

Obtain, analyze and interpret financial, clinical, quality and operational data from multiple internal and external data sources.
Maintain accurate, up to date analytical documentation and operational dashboards.
Conduct internal audits on prescription claims including 340B eligibility and respond to external payor audits.
Prepare ad hoc reports for management to understand financial, clinical, quality and operational issues.
Work collaboratively with other departments in the hospital to assist directors and managers in budgeting, variance analysis, achieving budget targets, and setting budget targets
Participate in the monthly budget variance reporting processes
Support during budget preparation and review

Seek new, innovative methods to continuously improve reporting processes and workflow.
Identify, develop and assist in the implementation of key metrics to measure process performance and opportunity
Provide quality control – ensure 100% accuracy and integrity of all data elements that are reported and distributed.
Demonstrate understanding of multiple system interfaces and workflow.Identify sources of truth related to data management.

Team/Interpersonal: Communicates clearly, responsively, and purposely with peers, managers and directors (collectively: “customers”) and other stakeholders. Focuses on team success and promotes collaborative efforts with others.

Able to adapt quickly to rapid change and multiple priorities from multiple stakeholders.
Excellent organization and time management skills.
Respond thoroughly and promptly to customer needs. Follow through with customers to closure.
Highly developed interpersonal skills are required to create behavioral changes in customers.

Customer Focus: Utilizes talents, skills, and knowledge in all assignments for the purpose of delivering excellent customer service. Guides preparation and delivery of information by seeking a thorough understanding of the department’s mission, goals, and values.

Provide departmental and end user support related to reports and systems used within the department including:
Train and develop staff related to reports, systems and interpretation of data.

Additional Functions

Professional Competencies
Prepares time estimates for project activities and develops project schedules, monitors performance and reports progress toward those milestones.
Analyzes information to ensure greater integration of functions within the organization.

Position Differentiators
Assists in the development of dashboards, budgets and timelines; consistent delivery and performance within established performance parameters.
Highly developed interpersonal skills are required to create behavioral changes in customers and deal with sensitive situations.
Maintaining required regular customer communications and reporting, keeping abreast of developments in patient care areas and tracking all analytical requests.
Leads the effort to identify and resolve data issues with end users.
Manages one low to medium risk project at a time.
Creative problem solving under the constraints of overarching management goals

Bachelor’s degree or 4 years of relevant work experience in lieu of degree
2-3 years related experience
Illinois Pharmacy Technician licensure with IDFPR within 60 days of hire
Certified Pharmacy Technician certification (CPhT) through PTCB or ExCPT through NHA required for all those licensed after 2008.
Newly licensed Technicians have 2 years from license effective date to obtain their certification.

Demonstrated excellent analytical skills
Excellent PC-based skills using Microsoft Products (Excel, etc.) and computer knowledge base
Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred:

Master’s Degree
Previous experience in healthcare analytics and finance

Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

We are seeking a highly motivated Data Analyst
to join the Data team within the Concept Research and Development department. As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting medical cost savings teams by providing data analysis for payment integrity concepts and ideas. The ideal candidate will have experience in claims processing or claims analysis, solid analytical skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Dublin or Letterkenny office and telecommuting from a home-based office in a hybrid work model.

Primary Responsibilities

Work closely with ideators and claims analysts to understand data requirements, then extract and manipulate data sets to meet those requirements
Collaborate with medical cost savings teams to identify opportunities for cost savings through data analysis
Support data research projects and work cross-functionally with other data teams to troubleshoot and identify data anomalies
Ensure data accuracy and attention to detail in all analysis

You will be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, as well as providing development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience in claims processing, claims analysis, or related functions
Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, VLOOKUP, macros, and similar analytical capabilities
Demonstrated solid analytical skills, with the ability to analyze complex datasets and derive actionable insights

Preferred Qualifications

Proven experience utilizing Snowsight
Proven experience in data engineering and Python development
Demonstrated knowledge of claims processing platforms, including UNET, NICE, COSMOS, FACETS, CIRRUS, or similar technologies
Demonstrated solid communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Demonstrated attention to detail and solid time management skills

Please note you must currently be eligible to work and remain indefinitely without any restrictions in the country to which you are making an application. Proof will be required to support your application.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

About The Opportunity

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop as an Analytics Engineer, Report Developer, and Business Analyst simultaneously. As a member of the Analytics team, you'll gain hands-on experience building data solutions, developing reporting assets, and delivering insights that help drive business decisions.

You'll have meaningful ownership of projects while working alongside experienced team members who provide technical guidance, business context, coaching, and mentorship. Our goal is to help you grow through real-world challenges, collaboration, and continuous learning.

We're looking for a curious, technically minded problem solver who enjoys learning, thrives on new challenges, and wants to make an impact through data.

Location Requirements

Note: W.B. Mason will not provide relocation assistance for this position.
This role will operate in a hybrid working environment, meaning employees will work partly remote and partly in-office, with in-office time required at least once per week. The primary in-office location for this role is located at our Corporate Headquarters Office in Brockton, MA.

Exciting Benefits Of a W.B. Mason Career

$60,000 - $70,000 salary
Blue Cross Blue Shield Health Plans with $0 deductible (in-network) for all plans, with various plan designs to meet you and your family's needs
Company-paid Cell Phone Plan with unlimited text, talk and data; add a family member for only $55/month per line!

What Makes Someone Successful In This Role

Technically Curious - You enjoy understanding how systems, data, and technology work. You're excited to learn new tools, explore unfamiliar concepts, and continuously expand your skills.
Driven Learner - You are self-motivated and committed to continuous improvement. You actively seek opportunities to learn, grow, and take on new challenges.

Detail Oriented - You take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work while maintaining momentum. You understand the balance between attention to detail and perfectionism.
Collaborative - You work effectively with teammates and business partners, openly share ideas, welcome feedback, and contribute to a positive team environment.
Coachable - You are receptive to feedback, eager to learn from experienced team members, and view guidance as an opportunity to accelerate your growth.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Analytics Engineering

Help build and maintain the data foundation that powers reporting and analysis across the organization.

Partner with senior team members to develop scalable data solutions

Improve data quality, automation, and analytical processes

Report Development

Develop and maintain Microsoft Fabric semantic models, dashboards, and reports
Create reporting solutions that track key performance indicators and business outcomes
Design clear visualizations that communicate trends, opportunities, and challenges
Continuously improve reporting through automation, standardization, and user feedback

Analysis

Use data to answer business questions and support decision making.

Analyze business problems using data-driven approaches
Identify trends, opportunities, and root causes
Routinely prepare and communicate analytical findings, insights, and recommendations to business stakeholders and executive leadership through verbal presentations and written communication.
Help translate analytical insights into actionable business decisions
Collaborate with teammates and business partners to solve problems and deliver results
Perform other duties and projects as assigned

Foundational understanding of SQL and Python-based coding concepts used to acquire, transform, and prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations in Power BI or Tableau that transform data into clear, actionable insights for business users.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel to organize, transform, analyze, and visualize data in support of reporting and business decision making.

Experience developing semantic models and writing DAX calculations in Power BI
Experience using web analytics platforms such as Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics

Evercore Wealth Management is seeking a Data Analyst to support and enhance the firm’s core business applications, data processes, and operational workflows. The Analyst will play a key role in supporting day-to-day system operations and data flows, troubleshooting issues, improving data quality, and partnering with stakeholders to drive process improvements. The Data Analyst will work closely with business, operations, and technology teams to understand existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement, support AI enablement and help deliver scalable solutions.

Support and maintain data throughout core business applications, including client relationship management, portfolio accounting, trading, and reporting systems
Help implement and enforce a data governance framework, including data quality standards, controls, and documentation
Assist in troubleshooting data and system issues, performing root cause analysis, and coordinating resolution with internal teams and external vendors
Analyze operational and financial data to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvement
Assist in evaluating and integrating AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, reporting, and decision-making
Partner with stakeholders to document current-state workflows and design more efficient future-state processes
Contribute to workflow automation initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce manual processes
Support ongoing system implementations and enhancements as part of the firm’s broader technology transformation
Create clear and concise documentation, including process flows, system guides, and training materials
Provide day-to-day user support and training to business teams as needed

Minimum 3 years of experience as a data or business systems analyst, operations, or similar role within financial services or a related industry
Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with and interpret data across multiple systems
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues and think critically to identify practical solutions
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Proficiency in data analysis and automation tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Python
Experience with portfolio accounting, trading systems, or reconciliation processes is preferred
Exposure to workflow tools, data governance concepts, and automation technologies
Interest in emerging technologies, including AI and data-driven solutions
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance, or a related field

Expected Base Salary Range: $90,000 - $120,000

In addition to a competitive base salary, employees may be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus delivered in the form of cash and/or deferred equity. Evercore also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility. These include, but are not limited to:

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in the Washington, DC metro area, CYNET SYSTEMS is a premier technology staffing and workforce solutions provider. Serving a diverse client base that includes Fortune 500 companies, government agencies, and enterprise organizations across the United States and Canada, CYNET SYSTEMS specializes in delivering agile, scalable talent solutions across various sectors such as IT, engineering, life sciences, clinical, and professional staffing. The organization holds certifications including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 Type II, underscoring its dedication to quality, security, operational excellence, and customer success.

About The Role

CYNET SYSTEMS is seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our Data Services Reporting team. This role is pivotal in supporting critical business operations through advanced data analysis, report development, and business intelligence solutions. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in SQL Server T-SQL development, report creation using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), and a keen ability to analyze complex datasets for actionable insights. As a key member of the team, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining complex stored procedures, ad hoc scripts, and reports that facilitate data-driven decision-making. The position offers an exciting opportunity to work with large-scale datasets, optimize query performance, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality data solutions that impact strategic business initiatives.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, along with a minimum of five years of professional experience in SQL Server development and reporting. Proven expertise in designing and optimizing complex stored procedures, functions, and T-SQL queries is essential. Strong experience with SSRS report development, including creating interactive dashboards and parameterized reports, is required. Familiarity with Visual Studio, TFS (Team Foundation Server), and source control practices is also necessary. Candidates should demonstrate excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Experience working within healthcare or insurance industry data systems, as well as knowledge of ETL processes and data warehousing concepts, will be considered a plus.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and optimize complex stored procedures for data extraction, transformation, and reporting purposes.
Create efficient T-SQL queries involving multi-table joins, subqueries, window functions, and conditional logic to support various business needs.
Develop and maintain ad hoc scripts for data analysis, troubleshooting, and specialized reporting requests, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
Implement data validation and quality assurance procedures to maintain high standards of data integrity.
Design, develop, and deploy SSRS reports, including dashboards, parameterized reports, drill-through reports, and nested report structures.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into technical solutions that provide actionable insights.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for process improvements.
Optimize report and query performance through indexing strategies and execution plan analysis.
Manage source code using Visual Studio and TFS, participate in code reviews, and ensure adherence to development standards.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of data models, procedures, reports, and development processes.

Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and Health Savings Account (HSA) options. We also provide short-term and long-term disability insurance, life and AD&D insurance, and paid sick leave in accordance with applicable state and local laws. Additional perks include supplemental insurance plans, identity theft protection, pet insurance, employee wellness programs, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We are committed to fostering career growth through ongoing professional development opportunities and a culture of continuous learning, enabling our employees to advance their skills and careers within a dynamic environment.

Equal Opportunity

We do not discriminate against any individual based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the Team
Global Business Marketing (GBM) at TikTok is at an inflection point. As the business evolves from establishing its brand presence to driving measurable commercial growth, the way we analyse, interpret and act on marketing performance needs to evolve with it. This role sits at the heart of that shift.

About the Role
GBM Strategy & Operations exists to transform strategic ambition into operational reality. A core part of that is ensuring that every marketing initiative we run, across every hub sub-function and every region, is measured against what it actually delivers for the business, not just what it produced in activity terms.

This is the role that owns that capability. As the leading Analyst, Performance & Insights, you will be the connective layer between GBM's global and regional teams, the Business Analytics organisation, building the measurement governance, analytical infrastructure, and commercial intelligence that allows the business to track impact against our P0 priorities, with New Client Acquisition and Marketing ROI as the two primary lens.

This is an experienced, hands on, individual contributor role for someone who isn't afraid to get their hands dirty while owning the measurement backbone of a global marketing function, not just report against it. You will work at the intersection of data, commercial strategy, and cross-functional governance, and your output will directly inform executive decision-making and business planning. Examples of key outputs include adhoc executive-level analysis reports and QBRs.

Responsibilities

Measurement Governance & Infrastructure
- Own and operationalise GBM's measurement governance framework — the methodology, standards, and processes that define how marketing impact is tracked consistently across global hub teams and regional spokes
- Design, govern, and continuously improve the performance dashboards and reporting infrastructure used across global and regional S&O
- Set data governance standards and ensure data integrity and consistency across reporting sources

Commercial Intelligence & P0 Priority Tracking
- Lead the tracking and reporting of impact against GBM's P0 business priorities, with New Client Acquisition as the primary focus area
- Produce executive-level analysis and QBR reporting that connects marketing execution to business outcomes, translating data into clear commercial narratives for leadership
- Lead deep-dive root cause analysis when performance diverges from plan, and partner with regional teams to understand and act on those findings

MarTech & Cross-Functional Partnership
- Serve as the primary S&O interface with MarTech and the MSO organisation on data infrastructure, measurement tooling, and how commercial intelligence flows between teams
- Partner with integrated marketing teams, including digital channels and events, on attribution and channel performance measurement, ensuring what is being tracked reflects real commercial impact

Regional Alignment
- Work closely with regional S&O leads to ensure a consistent measurement methodology is applied across all regions
- Working with multiple regional stakeholders within the broader marketing team and business analytics team across different timezones and cultures

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)
- Minimum 5+ years of experience in advanced analytics, business intelligence, or performance insights role
- Proven ability to translate complex data into executive-ready narratives, comfortable presenting to and influencing leadership
- Strong understanding of marketing ecosystems and how data flows between marketing, sales, and commercial operations, including familiarity with business analytics teams or equivalent commercial operations environments
- Strong SQL skills, with the ability to independently explore, transform, and validate data. Proficiency in Python for advanced analysis. Experience with A/B testing and experimental design.
- Proficiency in building visualizations and reports using tools like Looker, Tableau, or similar.
- Commercially oriented, you think about marketing in terms of outcomes, not just outputs

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Experience in a marketing, media, or platform business
- Highly organised and detail-oriented, you can manage multiple workstreams and deadlines without dropping the ball
- Clear written and verbal communicator, able to present findings in a way that is easy to understand and act on
- A bias toward simplification and action, not just strategising but being able to follow through with building systems and frameworks that make things clearer, not more complex
- Genuine curiosity about business to business marketing and GTM impact
- Exposure to or interest in B2B marketing environments or commercial go-to-market models
- Familiarity with OKR frameworks, planning cycles or reporting processes
- Some exposure to media attribution or marketing performance measurement, even at an introductory level
- Experience or interest in working across multiple markets or cultures

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

jobs.description:
Our mission and customers:
We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot
,

based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture

puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here
).

Our journey:
Founded in 2017 by Alexandre
and Steve
,
Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs:
We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process
because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto:
AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here
) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a People Data Analyst
to help Qonto’s People team turn HR data into clear insights and better-informed decisions.

Reporting to Mélodie Moulin, you will work closely with your People Systems teammates, HRBPs, and partners across People and Finance. You’ll combine hands-on analysis with an understanding of HR topics to answer practical questions, improve dashboards and reporting, and help stakeholders make better use of People data.

➡️ What you’ll do

Turn People data into actionable insights. Explore topics such as turnover, absenteeism, and performance, investigate trends, and communicate findings through clear analyses and concise recommendations.
Build and improve dashboards and reporting. Create reliable, easy-to-use reports, maintain consistent metric definitions, and help stakeholders understand what the data tells them. Keep People data reliable and usable. Validate data, document calculations, and contribute to mandatory reporting while following established access, confidentiality, and GDPR requirements.
Support HRBPs in their day-to-day decisions. Translate their questions into relevant analyses, discuss which KPIs are most useful, and help them become more autonomous through documentation and practical guidance.
Contribute to workforce and talent analyses. Prepare datasets, reports, and analytical inputs for topics such as headcount planning, compensation reviews, and talent reviews, in collaboration with the team.
Use AI to improve how you work. Apply AI to relevant analytical and reporting tasks, test practical ways to save time, and check the accuracy and reliability of outputs.

➡️ What we’re looking for

Relevant experience in People Analytics, HR reporting, or a data analytics role with substantial exposure to HR topics, ideally within a tech company or scale-up. A solid understanding of HR processes. Compensation reviews, talent reviews, and HRBP activities are familiar territory. You understand the questions behind a reporting request and can discuss whether a metric addresses them.
Hands-on analytical skills. You’re comfortable using SQL, Excel, and BI tools to combine datasets, check calculations, investigate trends, and build clear dashboards. Experience with HRIS reporting, particularly Workday, is a plus.
Clear communication and sound judgment. You can explain findings to non-technical stakeholders, ask useful questions, and distinguish what the data supports from what still needs investigating. Reliable delivery and collaborative working habits. You can progress independently on defined analyses, keep stakeholders informed, and flag blockers or competing priorities early.
Practical experience using AI. You already use AI in your work and can explain where it improves your efficiency or output quality, how you verify results, and how you protect sensitive information.
Professional fluency in English. French is a strong plus.

➡️ What we can offer you

Meaningful analytical work that helps the People team understand workforce trends and make better-informed decisions.
Varied HR topics, from performance and attrition to compensation, workforce planning, and reporting.
Close collaboration within a growing team, with opportunities to deepen both your analytical skills and your understanding of People topics.
Room to improve how work gets done, through clearer dashboards, reusable analyses, better documentation, and practical applications of AI.

➡️ Your future manager

You’ll report to Mélodie Moulin, Head of People Systems at Qonto
.

Their path?

Mélodie has 10+ years in HR systems and people operations, including leading large-scale HR transformation programs at Doctolib and Pernod Ricard, notably a global Workday deployment across 80+ locations. She joined Qonto to build a People Systems team from the ground up, using data and AI to help HR operate at scale.

What do they bring to the team?

Mélodie values autonomy, thoughtful problem-solving, and proactive collaboration. She brings a practical, solutions-focused approach, with clear expectations and space to develop your expertise while contributing to shared team priorities.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

On average, our hiring process lasts
20 working days
.
More information on our candidate journey here

🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it right away (support@qonto.com)

Desde hace más de 30 años, Devoteam se ha comprometido a poner la tecnología al servicio de las personas. Contamos con más de 11 000 empleados en todo el grupo, repartidos por 25 países de Europa, Oriente Medio y África.

Job Description

Buscamos un/a Data Analyst Senior
para incorporarse a un proyecto de larga duración (mínimo 2 años) en un importante cliente referente del Sector de las Telecomunicaciones
.

En este rol serás el nexo entre la ingeniería de datos y el negocio, encargándote de estructurar grandes volúmenes de información en Google Cloud Platform
, garantizar la calidad del dato y construir la capa semántica de visualización para la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Tus funciones principales:

Consultoría SQL & GCP: Realizar consultas complejas en BigQuery para extraer, limpiar y estructurar grandes datasets del sector telecom.

Modelado de Negocio & Forecast: Crear modelos analíticos y predicciones alimentados directamente desde BigQuery o Looker.
Optimización y Calidad del Dato: Definir y estructurar tablas optimizadas en BigQuery, asegurando la gobernanza, precisión e integridad de los datos consumidos en Looker o Excel.
Análisis Avanzado: Realizar manipulaciones de datos y análisis estadísticos apoyándote en Excel y consultas SQL avanzadas.

Experiencia: Mínimo 4-5 años trabajando como Data Analyst Senior o Analytics Engineer.
SQL & BigQuery: Dominio avanzado de SQL e historial trabajando con arquitecturas en BigQuery (GCP).
Ecosistema Looker: Experiencia sólida construyendo la capa semántica en Looker y diseñando cuadros de mando en Looker Studio.
Modelado: Habilidad demostrable en modelado de negocio, forecasting y manipulación avanzada en Excel.

Valorable: Experiencia previa previa dentro del sector de Telecomunicaciones.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

Moody's Corporation is a renowned global leader in credit ratings, research, and risk analysis. With a rich history of providing independent and insightful assessments of creditworthiness, Moody's helps organizations, investors, and governments make informed decisions in an increasingly complex financial landscape. The company is committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives and innovative thinking. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, including artificial intelligence and data analytics, Moody's transforms risk assessment into actionable insights, enabling clients to navigate uncertainty with confidence. The organization prides itself on its integrity, professionalism, and dedication to delivering high-quality services that support sustainable economic growth worldwide.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Data Analyst to join Moody's Data Management and Analytics team within the Customer Operations and Risk organization. This role is pivotal in designing and delivering trusted analytics, data products, and AI-enabled solutions that support critical business functions across the enterprise. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Business Intelligence, Financial Planning and Analysis, and Sales Analytics—to gather requirements, develop data models, and implement innovative solutions that enhance decision-making processes. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of data, technology, and business strategy, contributing to Moody's mission of transforming risk into opportunity. The role requires a strategic thinker with strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and a passion for leveraging data to solve complex business challenges.

Qualifications

A minimum of 10 years of experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and stakeholder management within business intelligence, analytics, or data product delivery, preferably supporting finance, revenue, lead-to-cash, or enterprise reporting environments.
Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and testable acceptance criteria.
Strong collaboration skills across business and technology teams, with the ability to influence design decisions and propose practical, business-aligned solutions.
Experience designing business-aligned data products, semantic models, reporting frameworks, and reusable analytics solutions in partnership with engineering teams.
Knowledge of data modeling, Lakehouse, and data warehousing concepts, including dimensional modeling, semantic layers, data quality, lineage, and governance.
Hands-on experience with analytics platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Power BI, or comparable tools; familiarity with CRM and source systems like Salesforce is preferred.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to validate data, challenge assumptions, and ensure reporting accuracy and usability.
Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts with practical experience in implementing AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. A growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to ethical AI use are essential.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Responsibilities

The Business Data Analyst will partner with various business and technology teams to design, develop, and implement trusted analytics, reporting, and data products, including AI-enabled solutions that drive business value.

Collaborate with stakeholders from Business Intelligence, Financial Planning and Analysis, Sales Planning, and Analytics teams to elicit, clarify, and prioritize reporting and data requirements.
Translate complex business problems into clear user stories, detailed business requirements, data definitions, and acceptance criteria to guide development efforts.
Evaluate and recommend architectural approaches across platforms such as Databricks, reporting layers, and analytical workflows, ensuring alignment with business needs and technical standards.
Facilitate workshops and working sessions with diverse stakeholders, managing expectations, scope, and trade-offs to ensure successful delivery.
Support data modeling activities, including defining dimensions, measures, hierarchies, and lineage, aligned with business semantics.
Contribute to the design of reporting solutions, source-to-target mappings, semantic layers, reusable data assets, and consumption patterns to optimize analytics efficiency.
Lead or support comprehensive testing of reports, datasets, and analytical outputs, validating results against source systems and business rules to ensure accuracy.
Ensure all solutions adhere to data quality, governance, usability standards, and identify opportunities for AI-driven automation and insights to enhance decision-making processes.

Benefits

Moody's offers a competitive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional growth of its employees. This includes comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, along with parental leave and paid time off to promote work-life balance. Employees are also eligible for a 401(k) plan with company matching contributions, life, disability, and accident insurance to provide financial security. Moody's supports continuous learning through tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities. The organization recognizes the importance of a positive work environment and offers flexible work arrangements where applicable. Additionally, employees can participate in a discounted stock purchase plan, fostering a sense of ownership and shared success within the company.

Equal Opportunity

Moody's Corporation is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital or familial status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Moody's provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities or those with sincerely held religious beliefs, in accordance with applicable laws. jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
¿Te gustaría convertir datos en decisiones que tengan un impacto real en el negocio?

En LIDERING
buscamos incorporar un/a Business Operations Analyst
con una combinación de visión de negocio, capacidad analítica y curiosidad por entender cómo funcionan las cosas.

No buscamos únicamente a alguien que construya dashboards o prepare informes. Queremos una persona que quiera ir un paso más allá: entender qué está ocurriendo en el negocio, por qué está ocurriendo y qué podemos hacer para mejorar.
Cuestionar constructivamente el "siempre lo hemos hecho así" y buscar maneras más eficientes de hacer las cosas. Que no se quede únicamente en el diagnóstico, sino que busca convertir sus análisis en decisiones y mejoras reales
.

Trabajarás de forma transversal con diferentes departamentos, analizando información financiera, comercial y operativa, entendiendo sus procesos e identificando oportunidades que nos ayuden a trabajar mejor y tomar mejores decisiones.

Si disfrutas convirtiendo preguntas de negocio en análisis, y análisis en decisiones
, queremos conocerte.

Misión

Impulsar la mejora del negocio a través del análisis de datos, la comprensión de los procesos y la identificación de oportunidades que permitan tomar mejores decisiones.

Tendrás una visión transversal de la compañía y trabajarás junto a las diferentes áreas para comprender cómo funciona el negocio, analizar sus resultados y transformar datos financieros, comerciales y operativos en insights, recomendaciones y acciones concretas.

Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, iniciativa y visión de negocio, capaz de combinar una mentalidad analítica con una clara orientación a resultados y mejora continua.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?

Analizar la evolución del negocio a través de datos de ventas, márgenes, rentabilidad, clientes, productos, compras y otros indicadores relevantes, identificando tendencias, desviaciones y oportunidades.
Transformar datos en insights y recomendaciones de negocio, ayudando a comprender qué hay detrás de los resultados y qué decisiones pueden contribuir a mejorarlos.
Trabajar de forma transversal con Ventas, Compras, Producción, Ingeniería y Finanzas, comprendiendo sus procesos y necesidades para identificar oportunidades de mejora y evaluar su impacto en el negocio.
Realizar análisis ad hoc y business cases para evaluar oportunidades, problemáticas o iniciativas desde una perspectiva económica y de negocio.
Definir y monitorizar KPIs de negocio y performance junto con los responsables de las diferentes áreas.
Diseñar, desarrollar y evolucionar dashboards y cuadros de mando en Power BI, convirtiendo la información disponible en herramientas útiles para la gestión y la toma de decisiones.
Identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos, utilizando los datos y el conocimiento del negocio para detectar ineficiencias, cuellos de botella y nuevas formas de trabajar.
Participar en proyectos transversales de mejora y transformación, aportando análisis, estructura y seguimiento de resultados.
Actuar como nexo entre las áreas de negocio, Finanzas e IT, traduciendo necesidades de negocio en requerimientos analíticos y contribuyendo al desarrollo de soluciones que aporten valor a los usuarios.
Contribuir a garantizar la calidad, coherencia y fiabilidad de la información, participando en la mejora del dato maestro y de las fuentes utilizadas para el análisis.
Impulsar una cultura cada vez más Data-Driven, ayudando a los equipos a interpretar la información y utilizar los datos como una herramienta habitual para tomar decisiones.
Colaborar con el equipo y participar en otras iniciativas relacionadas con la posición que contribuyan a los objetivos del negocio.
Aplicar los criterios y procedimientos ambientales definidos por la organización en el desarrollo de tus funciones.

¿Qué buscamos?

Más allá de la experiencia y los conocimientos técnicos, buscamos una persona con curiosidad por el negocio
.

Alguien que no se conforme con detectar que las ventas o el margen han cambiado, sino que quiera entender por qué
, hablar con las personas involucradas, analizar la información y conectar los puntos hasta llegar a una conclusión.

Nos gustaría que aportaras:

Formación universitaria en ADE, Economía, Finanzas, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística o similar. También valoraremos otras formaciones que aporten una buena combinación de capacidad analítica y orientación a negocio.
Aproximadamente 2-4 años de experiencia en posiciones relacionadas con Business Analytics, Business Operations, Control de Gestión, FP&A, Business Intelligence o análisis de negocio.
Buena visión económica y de negocio, con capacidad para interpretar indicadores de ventas, margen, rentabilidad, costes y evolución frente a objetivos.
Dominio avanzado de Microsoft Excel y experiencia trabajando con herramientas de Business Intelligence, preferentemente Power BI.
Se valorarán conocimientos de SQL y bases de datos relacionales.
Capacidad para entender cómo funcionan los procesos de diferentes áreas y relacionar la operativa del día a día con su impacto en los resultados.
Capacidad para interpretar los datos, cuestionarlos y convertirlos en conclusiones y recomendaciones accionables.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para relacionarte con perfiles muy diferentes, tanto técnicos como de negocio.
Inglés medio-alto, equivalente aproximadamente a B2/C1.

Será un plus si además tienes...

Experiencia con Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación/migración de ERP.
Experiencia en entornos industriales, distribución o B2B.
Experiencia en proyectos de mejora de procesos.

¿Cómo imaginamos a la persona que encajará especialmente bien?

Buscamos una persona:

🔎 Curiosa:
quiere entender qué hay detrás de los números.

📊 Analítica:
se siente cómoda trabajando con datos, pero sabe que el dato es un medio y no un fin.

💡 Proactiva:
identifica oportunidades y propone, sin limitarse a esperar una petición.

🤝 Transversal:
disfruta hablando con diferentes departamentos y entendiendo cómo funcionan.

💼 Con visión de negocio:
conecta decisiones operativas con ventas, margen, rentabilidad y resultados.

🚀 Con mentalidad de mejora:
cuestiona constructivamente el "siempre lo hemos hecho así" y busca maneras más eficientes de hacer las cosas.

🎯 Orientada a la acción:
no se queda únicamente en el diagnóstico, sino que busca convertir sus análisis en decisiones y mejoras reales.

No te encontrarás con un departamento de Business Analytics en Lidering, serás la única persona dentro de esta empresa con este rol y tendrás camino por delante por hacer, pero contarás con el apoyo no sólo de la empresa, sino también del grupo.

¿Por qué este puesto es diferente?

Porque no es una posición puramente de Data ni puramente de Finanzas
.

Los datos serán una de tus principales herramientas, pero tu objetivo será entender y mejorar el negocio
.

Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con diferentes áreas, conocer de cerca cómo funcionan sus procesos y convertir toda esa información en análisis y recomendaciones que puedan tener un impacto directo en la toma de decisiones.

Si eres de esas personas que cuando ve un dato piensa inmediatamente "¿por qué?"
y después "¿qué podemos hacer con esto?"
, probablemente nos entendamos bien.

Más sobre Lidering

Lidering
forma parte del Grupo EPI INDUSTRIES family of companies, con una trayectoria de más de 70 años en el mercado y con la misión de ofrecer productos y soluciones técnicas de calidad a nuestro cliente industrial, dentro de una amplia gama.

Dentro del Grupo, Lidering
es la empresa especializada en sellos mecánicos. Tiene más de 50 años en el mercado como expertos en sellos mecánicos y soluciones para la industria del bombeo y trasiego de fluidos.

En nuestras instalaciones de Lidering Cornellà
tenemos ubicada nuestra oficina.

Explora más en: https://www.lidering.com/

Apostamos por la igualdad de oportunidades y la diversidad
como pilares fundamentales de nuestra cultura.

Valoraremos positivamente las candidaturas de personas con certificado de discapacidad. Si necesitas algún tipo de adaptación durante el proceso de selección, no dudes en indicarlo.

Nuestro compromiso es garantizar procesos inclusivos y accesibles para todas las personas.

jobs.title: Research Analyst
jobs.description:
About G20 Group

G-20 Group is a cross-asset trading firm headquartered in Switzerland, trading delta-one and derivatives markets globally. We combine startup agility with institutional-grade experience in proprietary trading, technology, and quantitative finance.

Role Overview

As an expert Research Analyst at G-20, you will be responsible for producing high-conviction, actionable investment research across US equities, with a primary focus on Energy, the "Magnificent 7" mega-cap technology names, and Semiconductors. You will work closely with portfolio managers and traders to translate deep fundamental and thematic research into differentiated investment ideas, supporting G-20's decision-making across its trading and investment strategies.

Responsibilities

Conduct in-depth fundamental research and financial modeling on US Energy stocks, Magnificent 7 names (Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Nvidia, Meta, Tesla), and Semiconductor companies.
Develop and maintain detailed earnings models, valuation frameworks, and scenario analyses to support investment and trading decisions.
Monitor sector-specific catalysts, including earnings releases, capex cycles, supply/demand dynamics, regulatory developments, and technological trends (e.g. AI infrastructure buildout, chip supply chains, energy transition themes, OPEC+ policy).
Generate timely, well-argued investment theses and actionable trade ideas, clearly articulating risk/reward and key catalysts.
Build and maintain relationships with company management teams, sell-side analysts, and industry contacts to enhance information edge.
Track macro and geopolitical developments relevant to covered sectors (e.g. oil supply dynamics, semiconductor export controls, AI capex trends) and assess their portfolio impact.
Collaborate closely with portfolio managers and traders to size positions, manage risk, and refine entry/exit strategies based on research views.
Present research findings clearly and concisely through written notes and verbal briefings, ensuring key messages are actionable for trading decisions.
Continuously refine coverage frameworks, data sources, and analytical tools to improve research quality and efficiency.

Requirements

Degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field from a top-tier university; CFA or equivalent professional qualification is a plus.
Minimum 5+ years of equity research experience (sell-side or buy-side), with demonstrated coverage of Energy, large-cap Technology, and/or Semiconductor sectors.
Strong financial modeling, valuation, and analytical skills, with a track record of generating differentiated, high-conviction investment ideas.
Deep understanding of the drivers specific to each coverage area: commodity price dynamics and energy markets, mega-cap tech competitive positioning and AI-driven growth narratives, and semiconductor cycle/supply chain dynamics.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex analysis into clear, actionable investment views.
Proven ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced trading environment, with strong attention to detail and intellectual curiosity.
Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating effectively with traders and portfolio managers.

Preferred / Desirable Experience

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

CBRE Group, Inc. is a global leader in commercial real estate services and investment, renowned for its extensive reach and comprehensive service offerings. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, CBRE is a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company with a diverse workforce of over 140,000 employees worldwide. Operating in more than 100 countries, CBRE provides a wide array of services, including advisory, building operations and experience, project management, and real estate investments. The company's mission is to create value for clients by delivering innovative solutions and fostering sustainable growth. CBRE's core values emphasize respect, integrity, service, and excellence, which underpin its collaborative culture and commitment to diversity and inclusion. The organization continually strives to attract talented professionals who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact in the real estate industry.

About The Role

The Senior Data Analyst at CBRE plays a pivotal role within the Data Science & Analytics team, responsible for performing comprehensive data analyses to support strategic decision-making and business growth. This position involves reviewing and interpreting complex data sets related to global real estate markets and asset operations, ensuring that insights and recommendations are grounded in thorough research and accurate findings. The Senior Data Analyst will coordinate data aggregation efforts, develop and maintain data pipelines, and curate sophisticated reports using various business intelligence tools. They will also perform ad-hoc analyses, define intricate data requirements, and utilize programming languages and open-source tools to extract valuable insights. The role requires a keen eye for detail, strong judgment, and the ability to communicate complex data stories clearly across different organizational levels. Collaborating with agile development teams, the analyst will contribute to enhancing existing processes and developing new strategies to optimize data usage and improve business performance.

Key responsibilities include developing data structures, standardizing information, confirming data quality, and applying modeling techniques to identify opportunities for strategic improvements. The Senior Data Analyst will also lead efforts in creating detailed reports, presenting findings effectively, and supporting the organization in leveraging data-driven insights to achieve operational excellence. This role demands a combination of technical expertise, analytical thinking, and strong communication skills, all within a structured environment that values accuracy, integrity, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor's degree, preferably with 2-5 years of relevant experience in data analysis or related fields. A combination of education and practical experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. A Master’s degree is preferred. Candidates should have a solid understanding of standard procedures and techniques to solve moderately complex problems, along with the ability to apply technical knowledge and judgment effectively. Proficiency in Microsoft Office products, especially Word, Excel, and Outlook, is essential. Strong organizational skills, an inquisitive mindset, and the ability to understand and interpret complex data are critical for success in this role. Familiarity with programming languages, open-source evaluation tools, and data modeling techniques will be advantageous. The candidate should demonstrate excellent communication skills, capable of explaining complex insights in straightforward terms, and possess a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for data utilization and process improvements.

Responsibilities

Coordinate data aggregation and curate detailed reports utilizing various business intelligence and reporting platforms to support strategic initiatives. Perform ad-hoc and strategic reviews of structured and unstructured data, reflecting insights into global real estate markets and asset management operations. Develop and maintain data pipelines, ensuring data is organized, cleansed, and standardized to facilitate accurate analysis and reporting. Define complex data requirements, gather relevant information, and apply statistical tests to validate findings. Use programming tools and open-source software to plan models, analyze data, and extract actionable insights. Identify opportunities to maximize data utilization by applying modeling, optimization, and analytical techniques to develop innovative strategies that enhance business performance. Create ad-hoc reports based on ongoing reviews of existing data sources, providing timely insights to stakeholders. Ensure the quality and integrity of all data sources, confirming accuracy and consistency. Collaborate closely with agile development teams to recommend process enhancements, streamline data workflows, and improve reporting capabilities. Apply standard principles and techniques to solve routine and slightly complex problems, working within established guidelines and policies. Lead by example, demonstrating professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to CBRE’s core values. Effectively communicate complex data findings to diverse audiences, including non-technical stakeholders, ensuring clarity and understanding. Manage multiple priorities efficiently, meeting deadlines and maintaining high standards of work quality.

Benefits

CBRE offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' health, well-being, and financial security. Successful candidates will be eligible for a 401(k) retirement plan, dental, health, life, and vision insurance. The company also provides various wellness programs, paid time off, and opportunities for professional development. Employees can benefit from a competitive salary range, discretionary bonuses, and a collaborative work environment that encourages growth and innovation. CBRE is committed to fostering a positive workplace culture that values diversity, inclusion, and respect, ensuring all employees feel valued and empowered to contribute their best. Additionally, the company supports work-life balance through flexible work arrangements and ongoing learning opportunities to help employees advance their careers within a dynamic global organization.

Equal Opportunity

jobs.description:
Capital One, a Fortune 500 company and one of the nation’s top 10 banks, offers a broad spectrum of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared Values, come together to make Capital One a great company – and a great place to work.

We are looking for a forward-thinking, dynamic, and insightful Manager to join our Finance Integrated Program & Delivery (FIPD) team. In this role, you will lead high-impact strategic initiatives that are transforming how we work in Finance. You will serve as a central point of orchestration for a portfolio of high priority, complex initiatives across the Finance organization. This role will bring structure, discipline and a holistic Finance perspective to work that spans across multiple teams, stakeholders, and priorities – ensuring leaders have clear visibility into what is happening, where decisions are required, and what could impact successful delivery.

In addition to managing Finance initiatives, this role will help accelerate AI adoption within our team by developing a strong understanding of existing processes and ways of working, identifying opportunities where AI can create meaningful value, and helping translate those opportunities into actionable use cases.

A successful candidate will operate as more than a project manager. They will be expected to understand the broader business context, anticipate what is needed next, challenge teams when appropriate, and translate complex information into clear recommendations and actions for senior leadership.

General Responsibilities:

Executive Visibility: Develop concise decision-oriented updates that provide senior leaders with a clear understanding of progress, emerging issues, key decisions, and areas requiring leadership intervention
Strategic Communications: Own and drive clear, consistent, and timely communications across the portfolio, translating complex program information into audience-appropriate messaging for executives, stakeholders and delivery teams; ensure key decisions, priorities, risks, and changes are communicated effectively and drive shared understanding and action
Cross-Program Connectivity: Identify connections, overlaps, competing priorities, and opportunities across initiatives to ensure work is managed through enterprise lens
Proactive Risk and Dependency Management: Identify risks, dependencies, capacity constraints and potential delivery challenges early; drive mitigation plans and escalate issues before they impact critical outcomes
Decision Management: Establish clear mechanisms for capturing decisions, identifying decision owners, defining required inputs and ensuring decisions are made at the appropriate level and translated into action
Strategic Planning: Translate strategic priorities into executable plans, helping teams move from broad objectives to defined outcomes, workstreams, milestones and measurable success criteria
Forward-Looking Insights: Looking beyond current milestones to anticipate upcoming needs, decisions, risks, and organizational impacts, helping leadership stay multiple steps ahead
AI Opportunity Identification & Adoption: Develop a strong understanding of the team’s current processes and workflows to proactively identify opportunities where AI can simplify work, automate manual activities, improve insights or enhance how the team operates; partner with team members to evaluate, prioritize, and advance high-value opportunities from idea through implementation
Reporting & Analytics: Provide critical visibility into the AI portfolio. Utilize standardized reporting to track adoption, resource demand, and project health, replacing manual/bespoke reporting with self-service tools.
Continuous Improvement: Evaluate how work is managed today and introduce new tools, AI capabilities, automation, and operating practices that make program delivery faster, simpler, and more effective

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience
At least 5 years of Project Management or Program Management experience, including experience leading business transformation projects

Preferred Qualifications:

Masters / MBA degree
Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies in a technical or data-driven environment
SAFe certification
Experience with AI or GenAI-enabled projects, including familiarity with risk governance or AI model lifecycle management
Strong familiarity with Finance/Accounting operations and the challenges of legacy data ecosystems
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive consensus across disparate teams (e.g., Business, Tech, Risk, Data)

new_jobs.title: Senior Digital Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About The Role

6sense is hiring a Senior Digital Program Manager
to build and run the digital engagement engine for our Customer Success organization. This is a hybrid role: an expert-level Gainsight builder, program lead, and strategist. You will own the platform and, more importantly, You will own the platform and the quality of what gets built on it: the journeys, programs, and measurement that put CS strategy into action at scale. You are accountable for how they are built, for their accuracy, and for reporting on how they perform. Your primary focus will be to build and operate the digital programs that carry out CS strategy, report on where they are working and where customers are going unengaged, and recommend what to build next within CS priorities.

You will partner closely with CS Leadership, CS Operations, Marketing, Product, and Support. You are not a ticket-taker: you identify the gaps, propose the program, build it, launch it, and prove its impact.

What This Role Is – And Isn't

This role is for someone who has done this before and does not need a runway. We need a builder and program owner, not a resource waiting to be directed.

You move fast and ship. Journeys launch in weeks, not months. We do not wait for perfect requirements; we iterate.
You lead, not just execute. You do not wait for requests. You use data to find where customers are not being engaged, then bring a proposed program, a business case, and a plan.
You flag blockers immediately. Unclear or missing requirements are raised the same day, with a recommendation attached.
You own your backlog. You prioritize your own backlog and drive to resolution. We review outputs; we do not track status.
You know the difference between "I need input" and "I need permission." Judgment calls within scope get made. Questions that need business context get escalated quickly.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Program Strategy & Ownership

Own the strategy, roadmap, and calendar for CS digital programs across the customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
Design and launch strategic, segment-level programs and journeys, aligned to customer segmentation, health scoring, and CS coverage models.
Build the business case for each program: audience, objective, success metrics, content needs, and required resources. Prioritize the roadmap with CS Leadership.
Act as project and program lead for cross-functional digital initiatives, coordinating Marketing, Product, Support, Sales, and Enablement to deliver on time.
Pilot and evaluate new engagement channels and tactics (in-app, email, community, webinars, and others) and scale what works.

Digital Journey & Campaign Build

Design and build automated journeys in Gainsight, including conditional logic, multi-step triggers, and data-driven audiences.
Create, manage, and optimize email programs and in-app campaigns targeting customers at key lifecycle moments. Partner with Marketing and CS on messaging, and own campaign hygiene and governance.
Build and maintain audience segments, rules, and triggers for digital touchpoints; connect digital programs to CTAs and human-led plays so digital and CSM engagement work together.
A/B test content, timing, and cadence; report results and iterate.

Engagement Coverage & Gap Analysis

Track engagement: which customers, segments, and lifecycle stages are receiving touches, and which are not.
Identify and quantify gaps – unengaged accounts, stalled onboarding, low adoption, at-risk renewals with no digital or human outreach – and turn them into prioritized programs and recommendations.
Maintain a clear view of program progress against plan, and present findings and next steps to CS Leadership on a regular cadence.

Gainsight Platform Leader

Serve as the primary Gainsight Lead for Customer Success, owning building, data integrity, and platform health in regards to digital customer lifecycle.
Ensure Snowflake, Salesfoce, and other connectors data ingestion into Gainsight is usable for customer lifecycle programs
Document configurations, processes, and runbooks proactively.

Reporting, Analytics & Insights

Build and maintain dashboards and reports for CS Leadership
Track journey and program performance: reach, open and click rates, engagement, stage progression, product adoption, and influence on retention and expansion.
Provide regular, data-backed recommendations to improve program effectiveness and to inform coverage and resourcing decisions.

CS Ops & Leadership Partnership

Translate CS Leadership priorities and CS Ops workflows into programs and Gainsight builds quickly and with minimal hand-holding.
Participate in regular syncs with CS Ops and Leadership to gather requirements, share updates, and surface dependency gaps before they cause delays.
Enable CSMs to act on digital program outputs, and communicate program changes clearly.

Qualifications

Required

4–6+ years in Customer Success Operations, Digital/Scaled Customer Success, or lifecycle programs, including 3–5 years of hands-on Gainsight Building (or admin level type access).
Proven experience designing, building, and managing Journey Orchestrator programs and email campaigns from strategy through measurement.
Demonstrated program or project leadership: you have owned cross-functional initiatives and delivered measurable outcomes.
Strong understanding of the Gainsight data model – MDA, relationships, connectors, and Rules Engine.
Experience with Snowflake-to-Gainsight data ingestion, including connector setup, MDA mapping, and pipeline troubleshooting.
Proficiency with Salesforce integrations and how Gainsight syncs with SFDC, Snowflake, and other data providers.
Experience using data to identify engagement gaps and turn them into prioritized programs.
Working knowledge of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, and health scoring in a B2B SaaS environment.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver without oversight.
Track record of fast execution: you have built dashboards in a day and launched journeys in a week.
Strong written and verbal communication, with executive presence and the ability to document for technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have

Gainsight Admin certification.
Experience with health scoring model design and maintenance.
Hands-on experience with Pendo, including building in-app guides and messaging, defining behavioral segments, analyzing product usage and adoption, and using insights to trigger targeted digital CS journeys
Experience using Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and Workato to accelerate content creation, automate workflows, and scale digital CS programs.
Experience with lifecycle marketing, in-app messaging, or digital customer success programs at scale.
Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools; familiarity with SQL.
Experience in a commercial or mid-market CS motion supporting a large, digitally served customer base.

What Success Looks Like

First 15 days:
The Gainsight digital programs have been reviewed and the backlog is prioritized and agreed with CS Ops and CS Leadership. An initial engagement coverage baseline for the commercial book shows where customers are and are not being reached. Quick-win deliverables are shipped (dashboards, segments, reports), and at least one digital journey is live in production.

Within 30 days:
Existing journeys have been updated and new programs are being launched. Full program and campaign calendar is underway. A strategic program roadmap for the Commercial book is reviewed and approved by CS Leadership. Performance and gap reporting is in place and stakeholders are reviewing results.

Within 45 days:
Engagement gaps prioritized by CS Leadership have programs in market, with measurable movement in reach and engagement. A recurring cadence for program review and gap reporting is established, and digital and CSM-led motions are connected through CTAs and plays.

Base Salary Range: $92,812.50 - $136,125.00. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO).

Own service delivery of multi-tower (L1–L3) support teams spanning Infrastructure support, Help Desk, Desk-side support, Digital Workplace services, and Application support for Retail and Banking/Financial customers.

24+ years of overall IT experience, including 15+ years of onshore experience at customer locations (e.g., UK, Europe, APAC), and proven experience managing offshore delivery teams.
Strong experience leading Production Support teams for Financial and Retail customers, and improving margins through continuous service improvement and service delivery excellence.
Demonstrated experience managing Infrastructure projects, cloud migration, and transformation programs in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Experience managing service delivery of support teams (up to 80+ headcount) as per contractual terms, spanning Infrastructure support, Help Desk, Desk-side support, Digital Workplace, and Application support.
Experience partnering with Sales teams on solutioning, resourcing, and transformation opportunities for Infrastructure managed services deals.
Working knowledge of OT/ICS technologies and concepts (SCADA, DCS, PLC, HMI, MES, Purdue Model/ISA-95) and OT cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443, NIST) is highly desirable for IT/OT convergence engagements.
Excellent stakeholder management, vendor management, and people management skills, with strong verbal/written communication and a fast learner's approach to new tools and technologies.

Areas of Expertise

Infrastructure Management & Project Management
Stakeholder Management & Vendor Management
Service Transition, Service Operations & Continual Service Improvement
Incident Management, Problem Management & Change Management
Budget Management & People Management

Preferred Skills & Tools

EUC & Collaboration Tools: Intune, O365 suite, OKTA, Citrix, Teams, WebEx, Zoom.

Service Management Practices: ITIL, Shift Left/Shift Right, LEAN/Six Sigma project management.
Experience with manufacturing/industrial, Retail, and Banking/Financial clients, and cross-border/global delivery models (UK, Europe, APAC).
Ability to manage multiple concurrent IT/OT projects/workstreams and mentor junior project coordinators and support engineers.

PRINCE2 Foundation and Practitioner Certificate in Project Management (or PMP equivalent).

ITIL Foundation certification is an added advantage.
