new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Technology
new_jobs.description:
Brio Water Technology, a Home Organizers, Inc. company,
is a market leading water products brand that has helped millions stay hydrated through its unique and innovative product line. We offer full home water solutions designed to elevate the way people hydrate, combining sophisticated technology with modern, top tier design to deliver exceptional performance, customer satisfaction, and enhanced functionality.

Home Organizers, Inc.
is the parent organization behind a portfolio of well-known home products and services brands, including Closet World, Closets by Design, Brio Water Technology, and others. With decades of experience supporting innovation, design, manufacturing, and customer focused solutions, Home Organizers helps its brands deliver high quality products and services that improve everyday living for households across the country.

About the role

As part of Home Organizers, Inc., Brio Water Technology is looking for a Program Manager, Technology to build the program governance, standards, and processes that do not yet exist within our technology organization. This is a foundational, hands-on role for someone who walks into ambiguity and sees opportunity rather than a problem.

This role is deliberately two jobs in one. As the business analyst, you define the problem, outline the scope, and make sure the solution fits what the business actually needs. As the program manager, you own the budget, hold the timeline, and deliver through the team. We are looking for someone who does both, and who knows which one a given moment calls for.

The right person starts with people, not plans: they talk to our internal customers, learn their pain points, understand the current state, and use what they learn to design the processes and procedures we do not yet have. They are proactive by default. Wherever there is a compliance concern, an undocumented procedure, or a process with no owner, they step in, create clarity, and carry it until a permanent owner is in place. They do not wait to be assigned work; they find the gaps, close them, and hand them off.

This person arrives with Agile coaching experience already in hand. As our teams mature and grow, they will take on Scrum Master duties and coach teams of varying size and experience. All of it requires influence without authority, and comfort operating alongside senior leaders and executives who hold deep institutional knowledge of how our systems actually behave.

Objectives of the role

Establish the program governance, standards, and compliance foundation our technology organization does not yet have, in close partnership with internal stakeholders.
Take ownership of gaps: compliance concerns, undocumented procedures, and unowned processes, creating clarity and carrying them until a permanent owner is in place.
Lead cross-functional technology programs end to end, from problem definition and requirements through delivery, coordinating teams and vendors outside your direct management chain.
Take on the role of Scrum Master, Agile Coach, and business analyst for one or more teams as our organization matures.

What you'll do

Strategic planning.
Define the roadmap, goals, and long-term vision for assigned programs, and sequence the work so near-term delivery builds toward the target state.
Business analysis.
Define the problem before the solution is chosen. Elicit and document requirements, map current and future state, set scope, and write acceptance criteria, confirming that what gets built fits what the business actually needs.
Stakeholder communication.
Serve as the primary bridge between project teams, executives, and external partners. Run working sessions, keep everyone current on status, risks, and decisions, and work directly with stakeholders up to the executive level and with subject matter experts who hold deep institutional knowledge of how our systems behave.
Change management and adoption.
Many of our teams have worked in the same systems, using the same processes, for a very long time. Adoption here is earned, not announced. Communicate change early and often, brief the leadership of each area before rollout so their questions are answered ahead of go-live, and provide the training and hands-on support people need to work confidently in the new process. Success is measured by adoption, not by the go-live date.
Program delivery.
Lead cross-functional technology programs end to end: system implementations, migrations, and infrastructure initiatives, coordinating teams outside your direct management chain, including external vendors, internal business stakeholders, and technical SMEs.
Cross-project coordination.
Manage interdependencies across concurrent projects, surface scheduling and resource conflicts early, and drive them to resolution.
Budget oversight.
Allocate resources, forecast expenses, and own budget adherence and variance tracking for assigned programs, including vendor software licensing, capital expenses for infrastructure upgrades, and cloud costs.
Risk management.
Identify roadblocks and risks early and implement corrective action. Maintain the risk register, change control process, policies and procedures, and audit-ready documentation.
Governance and gap ownership.
Stand up program governance where none exists today. Proactively identify compliance concerns, undocumented procedures, and processes without a clear owner; create interim structure, carry ownership, and hand off to permanent owners once established.
Agile leadership.
Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Agile teams, coaching teams of varying size and maturity as the organization scales.

Qualifications

3-5 years of program or project management experience, including managing individual program or project budgets between $250,000 and $1,000,000.
Cross-functional IT program delivery: has led system implementations, migrations, or infrastructure programs end to end, across teams they did not manage, including teams that spanned external vendors and internal SMEs.
Compliance and governance experience: has operated inside an audited or regulated environment (for example SOX, HIPAA, PCI, or SOC 2) and can re-create the artifacts it runs on: risk register, change control process, policies and procedures, and audit evidence. Prior authorship of these artifacts is not required; applied familiarity is.
Business analysis and business partner engagement: has gathered and documented requirements, run working sessions, and translated business needs into technical scope, working directly with stakeholders up to the executive level.
Hands-on Agile delivery experience and demonstrated Agile coaching experience, with the ability to serve as Scrum Master for one or more teams as the organization grows.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, current and in good standing.

Preferred Skills

Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).
Familiarity with formal change-management methodologies and stakeholder-management practices.

Position Overview

QinetiQ US is looking to hire an experienced Senior Program Manager to support the development and production of the company’s Next Generation Advanced Bomb Suit (NGABS) program in Franklin, MA.

The NGABS Senior Program Manager role is a senior leadership position responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and management of the NGABS program, ensuring it meets mission requirements, budget, and schedule goals.

Responsibilities

Role Overview

The Program Manager for the NGABS program leads the acquisition and operational management of the Next Generation Advanced Bomb Suit, a modular, mission‑tailorable protective system for Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) soldiers. The position ensures the suit’s design, integration of advanced technologies, and field deployment align with the U.S. Army’s mission to protect EOD personnel from blast, fragmentation, heat, flame, and other threats

This will be an on-site position focused on the following areas:

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership: Direct the NGABS program from development completion, First Article Testing (FAT), and production, in coordination with the Program Acquisition Executive Maneuver Ground and other stakeholders. Act as primary customer interface for all program aspects and lead program reviews to discuss technical, cost and schedule activities.
Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise with military users, industry partners, and government agencies to align technical and operational requirements.
Budget & Schedule Management: Manage the program budget, timelines, and resource allocation to deliver on schedule and within cost constraints. Create program plans including the development of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for management of scope to ensure alignment with contract requirements, budgets, and internal commitments.
Team management: Understand the role and responsibility of each program team member, and through expert communication and leadership skills, establish a common understanding among team members on scope, schedule, and financial objectives. Work with functional managers to develop program resource plans. Direct assigned program resources.
Risk & Compliance: Identify potential program risks, implement mitigation strategies, and ensure compliance with acquisition regulations and safety standards.
Testing & Evaluation: Oversee trials, evaluations, and feedback loops to refine the NGABS before full adoption.
Experience: Proven leadership in complex defense or technology acquisition programs, with a track record in managing high‑risk, high‑cost initiatives.Recent experience successfully managing a product development and/or production program.
Management Skills: Strong project management, budgeting, and stakeholder engagement abilities.
Regulatory Compliance: Familiarity with U.S. Army acquisition processes and defense procurement rules.
Monitor and assess program performance against plan (schedule and financial), identify risk and scope changes, develop and implement corrective action when necessary to initiate program changes. Maintain MS Schedule regularly.
Control expenditures per the project budget and report monthly on project budget to actual performance via the Estimate to Complete (ETC) process.

Required Qualifications

Minimum of 8 years of Project/Program Management experience leading development and/or production programs in support of the US Federal Government.
B.S./B.A. in Engineering, Science, Mathematics, Business, or equivalent
Advanced working knowledge of FAR, DFAR, SOW’s, Performance Specifications, Performance Documents (PD), and similarly related contract documents.
Proven track record of managing programs with challenging technical, schedule, and cost requirements as well as complex customer and subcontractor relationships.

About Rec

Think about the last time you tried to book a tennis court. Or sign your kid up for a swim lesson. Or find an open rec league that actually fits your schedule. You probably ended up on a website that looked like it was built in 2003 — or even worse, filled out a piece of paper.

$3T is spent on recreation globally, and it's built on a completely fragmented system that's largely untouched by technology.

At Rec (recreation.ai), we're using AI to change that — reimagining how the world plays, participates in community, and gets active. Our vision is simple: more recreation for everyone. We sit at a rare intersection — a consumer product loved by everyday players and an enterprise platform trusted by the organizations that power recreation.

We're a small team with firepower. Our founders were among the first few hundred at Uber, then led teams at The Athletic and MasterClass. The rest of the team combines builders from Google, Microsoft, Strava, Hipcamp, and Airbnb.

People join Rec for two reasons: you want to build AI that gets people back in the real world, and you want to work with really smart people.

About The Role

We are looking for a Sr Deployment Strategist to join our team. This role is a unique opportunity to be a part of the early Rec team and help define the operations, business strategy, and culture of the organization. You will work closely with best-in-class operations, sales, product, and engineering leaders across the company.

You will primarily be responsible for managing everything it takes to make our largest and most complex enterprise-size city partners a success. This includes joining sales pursuits for enterprise clients as our implementation and product expert, leading implementations, and managing relationships with senior city officials. You will also act as a voice internally within the company advocating for the product and operational needs of our largest and most complex customers.

This is a role for the client operations “athlete”, a voracious learner that wants exposure to all aspects of our B2B SaaS business and is relentlessly resourceful in achieving their goals. You should have experience managing senior clients and comfortable driving results across long term and complex projects. This is a strategic role and we will give you both the freedom and responsibility to become the domain expert trusted to make the right calls. However, this is also a hands-on early stage role where strategic insight comes from putting in the execution work yourself.

What You’ll Own

Onboard, retain, and grow customer accounts. You’ll lead the onboarding of new cities, manage relationships with existing partners, and strengthen customers’ engagements with Rec through renewals and expansion.
Own the customer relationship. You’ll own the customer relationship with cities, serving as a trusted advisor and partner to executive and senior leadership across various functions.
Build the customer success processes and playbook. Set the standard for an excellent customer experience and build the playbooks and processes to support this experience for your customers.
Synthesize, prioritize, and share learnings cross-functionally to shape product and business decisions. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners, especially product and sales, to distill learnings from your experience with cities, clearly synthesize and prioritize those learnings, and work with internal stakeholders to translate them into targeted improvements. You’ll directly shape the product development and sales targeting processes.

Who You Are

3-6 years working in Customer Success at a tech company or startup, at a top consulting firm or finance firm, or a combination of both.
2+ years experience managing clients at the enterprise level. Either large corporate or government clients
You have strong client-services experience. You’re cool under pressure in front of senior client stakeholders and know how to manage key relationships
You are a strong communicator. You can crisply communicate actionable data-driven insights and pitch tailored solutions to solve customers’ problems
You are a strategic problem solver. You can break down ambiguous problems and apply a first principles approach to solving them
You have exceptional project management skills. You can juggle multiple complex projects in flight and can reprioritize quickly
You have an entrepreneurial spirit and a high degree of drive, energy, and passion for creating and managing world-class operational processes
You are scrappy and resourceful. When something needs to get done, you always find a way to make it happen.

Our Values

Be Relentless. Move fast. Own it. Ship real value early and often.
Win Together. Speak up, go beyond the boundaries of your role. That's how we win.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At Emburse, you’ll not just imagine the future – you’ll build it. As a leader in expense intelligence, we are creating a future where technology drives business value and inspires extraordinary results. Our AI-powered platform helps organizations modernize financial operations, increase visibility, and optimize spend across the enterprise.

The Implementation Project Manager plays a pivotal role in delivering seamless software activations and configurations for new and expanding enterprise clients. Acting as the functional and technical expert, you will lead clients through the end-to-end implementation lifecycle—from analyzing sales orders and gathering requirements to final software deployment and client handoff. You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, designing tailored software configurations that position clients for long-term operational success.

In this role, you will take full ownership of project scoping, timeline management, and cross-functional risk mitigation. You will meticulously review initial sales details to spot potential risks before kickoff, ensure all deliverables align with customer expectations, and maintain proactive, clear communication with both internal and external stakeholders. Leveraging both user-interface settings and back-end databases, scripts, and administrative tools, you will build and validate solutions that modernize our clients’ expense operations while keeping projects on schedule and within scope.

Please note we are not able to offer sponsorship now OR in the future

What you will Do:

Enterprise Client Onboarding: Lead end-to-end software implementations for large, enterprise-market clients (CER), taking primary ownership of high-revenue, complex, and strategic projects.
Requirements & Discovery: Facilitate client kick-offs, requirement-gathering sessions, and discovery meetings to translate business needs into tailored software capabilities.
System Configuration & Setup: Configure Emburse software according to project scope using user-interface settings, back-end configurations, and administrative tools to meet client requirements.
Mentorship & Team Leadership: Serve as a mentor, trainer, and functional resource for Implementation Specialists, guiding team members on best practices and technical onboarding.
Escalation Point: Act as the primary escalation contact for internal team members regarding product, process, and complex technical or troubleshooting questions.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Customer Success, Development, and Product teams to align on client needs, manage technical escalations, and execute seamless handoffs.
Process & Efficiency Improvements: Help develop and update core implementation workflows, providing guidance and feedback to refine internal tools, reduce turnaround times, and boost efficiency.
Project & Scope Management: Track milestones, manage deliverables, and handle multiple concurrent implementations within workload expectations while proactively mitigating risks.
Stakeholder Communication: Deliver exceptional, consultative customer service and maintain clear, regular status updates with client-side and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Product Expertise: Maintain advanced technical knowledge of Emburse solutions through continuous learning, testing, and collaboration to guide clients toward optimal long-term system usage.

What you will Bring:

5+ years of project management experience in a software delivery organization, including active involvement or leadership within a PMO environment.
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is highly desirable.
Strong understanding of corporate accounting systems, financial practices, and industry terminology relevant to expense and financial operations.
Hands-on mastery of the end-to-end project lifecycle, with a proven ability to manage complex, enterprise-level implementations with minimal oversight.
Exceptional customer-handling skills with demonstrated success navigating complex client escalations, resolving concerns, and exercising influence with external stakeholders.
Skill in analyzing business data to understand client operations, identify core requirements, and deliver actionable, high-value configuration insights.
Strong ability to see the "big picture," evaluate workflows, and execute efficient, scalable implementation processes across projects.
Excellent business writing and verbal communication skills, with fluency in articulating the value of structured project management practices to clients and internal teams.

new_jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About The Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.

This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.

What You'll Do

Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.
Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.
Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders.
Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.
Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.
Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.
Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.
Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

What You Bring

Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.
Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.
Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.
Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.
Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.
A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

Bonus Points

Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments
Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards
Experience working with platform or API products
Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)
Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ at Kungsgatan 12-14 in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.

How To Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
Technical interview with some of our Engineering team
Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads
Home case and presentation at our office - Join us in the Stockholm office for a lunch, a presentation and som pair programming to experience our our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Benefits

Competitive salary & company stock options
30 days/year of paid vacation
5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives
Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents
Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
Mental health support through our partner Mindler
Pension program
Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.

We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

The Strategic Program Manager will lead high-impact growth and transformation programs across Advanced Services, turning strategic priorities into coordinated, measurable execution.

Working across Sales, Delivery, Portfolio, Finance and other Everpure organizations, the role will establish and run programs designed to accelerate services growth, customer adoption and organizational transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Growth Programs — Design, launch and manage programs that accelerate adoption, pipeline, bookings and revenue growth, including incentive-led and customer adoption initiatives.
Program Strategy & Execution — Translate strategic priorities into structured programs with clear objectives, work streams, milestones, ownership and measurable outcomes.

Continuous Improvement — Use performance data and field/customer feedback to evolve programs, resolve barriers and determine when initiatives should scale, change or conclude.
Executive Communication — Provide clear updates on progress, risks, decisions and business impact to senior leadership.

What You Bring

Strong experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through execution.
Commercial mindset with an understanding of how programs drive adoption, pipeline, bookings and revenue growth.
Ability to turn ambiguous strategic priorities into clear plans, work streams, ownership and measurable outcomes.
Strong stakeholder leadership across Sales, Delivery, Portfolio, Finance and other business functions.
Experience influencing and driving execution across teams without direct authority.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders while remaining close to execution.
Data-driven approach to measuring performance, identifying barriers and adapting programs based on results.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and taking ownership of new or evolving strategic priorities.

What Success Looks Like

Strategic priorities are translated into well-defined programs with clear ownership, execution plans and measurable outcomes.
Growth programs demonstrate tangible impact on customer adoption, pipeline, bookings and revenue.
New capabilities, acquisitions and organizational changes are successfully integrated into Advanced Services.
Cross-functional stakeholders are aligned around common objectives, responsibilities and execution.
Program performance is visible through clear metrics, reporting and executive communication.
Successful initiatives are scaled and embedded into the business, while programs that are not delivering expected outcomes are adapted or concluded.
Advanced Services is better positioned to execute against Everpure's strategic growth priorities.

new_jobs.title: Competitive Intelligence Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Competitive Intelligence (CI) Program Manager keeps iCIMS one step ahead of the competition. You’ll run the day-to-day engine of our CI program — collecting, synthesizing, and distributing competitive and market intelligence so Sales, Product, and Marketing can make faster, sharper decisions.

You’ll build that engine AI-first. We expect you to use generative AI, agents, and automation to monitor the market continuously, turn raw signals into insight in hours instead of weeks, and scale CI well beyond what one person could do manually. You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, Labs, Decision Support, and senior leadership, and your work will inform pricing, product strategy, sales tactics, corporate development, and marketing campaigns.

This is a high-visibility role for a curious, tech-forward self-starter who doesn’t wait to be asked — someone who spots a competitor’s move first, knows what it means for ICIMS, and gets the answer to the right people before the question comes up.

About Us

ICIMS is a leading enterprise hiring platform that combines the scale and reliability of enterprise software with the transformative power of AI. Thousands of organizations across more than 200 countries and territories trust ICIMS to find and hire the people who shape their future and drive their business forward. Powered by insights from billions of hiring interactions, continuous AI innovation, and a highly extensible platform, ICIMS helps organizations turn talent acquisition into a competitive advantage. For more than 25 years, ICIMS has delivered end-to-end hiring solutions that improve recruiting efficiency, reduce costs and create exceptional candidate experiences.

ICIMS helps solve one of the biggest challenges businesses face today: building a workforce that can adapt, scale, and perform in an increasingly competitive and unpredictable talent market. We uniquely do that by combining enterprise-grade hiring technology, AI-powered insights and automation, and connected talent experiences to help organizations improve hiring outcomes while driving measurable impact.

Responsibilities

Own the ongoing collection, analysis, and synthesis of intelligence on ICIMS’ tier 1 and tier 2 competitors, including product offerings, go-to-market strategies, sales motions, pricing models, and key differentiators
Build and run AI-powered market monitoring; design agents and automated workflows that track competitor news, product releases, pricing, reviews, hiring signals, and earnings, and surface what matters without manual digging
Proactively flag emerging threats and trends, bringing a point of view on what they mean for ICIMS and a recommended response, not just a report of what happened
Publish a recurring competitive digest and real-time alerts for leadership and the field, automated wherever possible
Run win/loss analysis in partnership with Product Marketing, Product Management, and third-party research vendors, using AI to mine interviews, call recordings, and deal data for the patterns and root causes that move win rates
Manage day-to-day vendor relationships that support our CI and win/loss programs, ensuring deliverables meet business needs
Maintain internal competitive lists for Win Against, Saves, and Takeaways on a monthly basis
Partner with Decision Support to deliver accurate, timely CI reporting, and continuously improve its relevance and usability
Keep competitive profiles, battlecards, feature comparisons, and other enablement assets current in the CI portal.
Draft competitor positioning documents aligned with ICIMS’ overall messaging and value proposition
Partner with Sales Enablement and Product Marketing to turn competitive insights into sales plays, objection handling, and field training
Present competitive findings in team meetings, field enablement sessions, and executive briefings
Continuously test new AI tools and techniques, and share what works so the broader marketing team gets faster too

Qualifications

3-5 years of experience in competitive intelligence, market intelligence, product marketing, or a related strategic analysis role (B2B SaaS strongly preferred)

WWC Global, an operating firm of Command Holdings, is seeking a Vendor Threat Mitigation (VTM) Program Analyst to support the J45 within Indo-Pacific Command (INDOPACOM).

This position provides critical Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) and Vendor Threat Mitigation (VTM) planning, coordination, and intelligence-integration. The role ensures the security and resilience of the theater supply chain by identifying, assessing, and mitigating vendor-related risks—including foreign ownership, control, or influence (FOCI), cyber vulnerabilities, and adversarial exploitation—across the Area of Responsibility (AOR). The role is highly dynamic and adaptive to command priorities; requiring an experienced professional who can operate independently with minimal guidance.

Key Responsibilities May Include But Are Not Limited To

Conducting rigorous supply chain illuminations and vendor threat assessments to identify FOCI, cyber vulnerabilities, and adversarial influence risks within the AOR, ensuring mission requirements are protected from compromised suppliers.
Developing and implementing theater-specific VTM mitigation strategies and risk response plans, ensuring alignment with DoD security protocols and mission-critical function protection.
Supporting VTM planning for Tier 1 and Tier 2 Exercises (e.g., Balikatan, Cobra Gold), ensuring theater supply chains are modeled, stress-tested against subversion, and assessed during major training events.
Synchronizing vendor threat intelligence and mitigation strategies with USFK, USFJ, SOCPAC, and regional Service Components. Coordinating with DCSA, DLA, and USTRANSCOM to ensure a unified theater defense.
Serve as a subject matter expert for VTM policy and governance. Draft formal staff products (EXSUMs, Info Papers) and deliver executive-level briefings to General/Flag Officers (GO/FO) regarding theater supply chain vulnerabilities.
Demonstrating a deep understanding of, and the ability to apply, Joint Publications, Directives and Instructions with the associated policies that support theater distribution security and vendor threat mitigation. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled: Sigma Defense Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 5+ years of relevant experience.
3+ years in the Department of Defense contracting market of major weapon systems product development and acquisitions.
Familiarity with cybersecurity compliance tools such as STIG Viewer and eMASS

As our Security Operations Manager, you'll lead the ongoing development and maturity of our cyber security operations capability, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity and availability of our information, systems and services.

This is a newly established role with a unique opportunity to shape and strengthen our security operations function. Leading a growing team and working closely with strategic service providers, you'll be responsible for building capability, embedding best practice, and ensuring our cyber security controls, processes and responses remain effective in an evolving threat landscape.

As Security Operations Manager, you will:

Lead the day-to-day cyber security function and security team.
Oversee security operations, incident response, vulnerability management and security monitoring activities.
Drive cyber security governance, risk management, compliance and continuous improvement initiatives.
Build and maintain strong relationships with security vendors, managed service providers and SOC partners.
Provide security leadership and advice across technology projects, infrastructure, cloud platforms and emerging technologies.
Develop and promote a positive security culture through education, awareness and stakeholder engagement.
Lead security reporting, metrics and performance management activities.
Contribute to the development and execution of Hato Hone St John's cyber security strategy and roadmap

This is an opportunity to shape the future of cyber security within one of New Zealand's most recognised and trusted organisations. You'll work across the business to influence decision-making, improve security outcomes, and help ensure the technology services that support our people, patients, volunteers and communities remain secure and resilient.

The role is a permanent full-time opportunity based in Auckland or Christchurch.

Proven experience in a cyber security leadership or management role. (Experience gained from within health / emergency services is a bonus).

Experience supporting security compliance, audit and assurance activities.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical risks into business outcomes.

new_jobs.title: Regional Sustainment Framework Program Analyst
new_jobs.description:
WWC Global, an operating firm of Command Holdings, is seeking a Regional Sustainment Framework (RSF) Program Analyst to support the J4 Logistics Directorate within Indo-Pacific Command (INDOPACOM).

This position provides critical logistics planning, operational coordination, and strategic analysis support to the U.S. Pacific Command (USPACOM) Logistics and Engineering Directorate (J4), in operationalizing the Department of Defense Regional Sustainment Framework (RSF). The role is assigned to the Multinational Logistics Branch, Plans & Exercise Division (J45) focuses on optimizing theater-level maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) capabilities, strengthening bilateral/multilateral logistics partnerships, and integrating logistics posture into the broader Theater Campaign Plan (TCP), Theater Posture Plan (TPP) and Theater Security Cooperation Program (TSCP).

Key Responsibilities May Include But Are Not Limited To

Serving as a key contractor supporting USPACOM sustainment resiliency objectives.
Conducting high-level logistics capability assessments, facilitating partner engagements and drafting bilateral agreements.
Integrating regional Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) initiatives into major joint operations, security cooperation activities, and respective theater defense plans.
Collaborating across multi=echelon Joint Logistics Enterprise (JLEnt) organizations and foreign military counterparts.
Operationalizing the DoD Regional Sustainment Framework (RSF) strategy within the USPACOM Area of Responsibility (AOR).
Identifying, assessing, and leveraging regional, bilateral, and multilateral MRO capabilities to build forward-deployed sustainment resilience.
Planning, coordinating, and executing bilateral logistics staff talks, working groups, and forums with regional allies and key partners (e.g., Australia, Japan, South Korea, Philippines, Singapore).
Supporting the drafting, negotiation, and maintenance of bilateral logistics instruments, including Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreements (ACSA), Memoranda of Understanding / Agreement (MOU/MOA) and Implementing Arrangements (IA).
Aligning regional sustainment initiatives with the USPACOM Theater Security Cooperation program.
Coordinating logistics capacity-building projects, Excess Defense Articles (EDA) transfers, and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) sustainment to ensure long-term partner nation interoperability and maintenance self-sufficiency.
Ensuring all regional sustainment plans, bilateral arrangements, and security cooperation activities comply with applicable Department of Defense Directives (DoDD), Instructions (DoDI), Joint Publications, and statutory authorities (Title 10 USC).
Synchronize RSF and bilateral initiatives across USPACOM Service Components (USARPAC, PACFLT, PACAF, MARFORPAC), Sub-Unified Commands (USFK, USFJ, SOCPAC, SPACE-PAC), the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Acquisition and Sustainment (OUSW(A&S)), Joint Staff J4, and Defense Agencies (DLA, DSCA).
Draft high-quality staff products, including Executive Summaries (EXSUMs), Information Papers, Action Memoranda, and Talking Points. Deliver executive-level briefings to General/Flag Officers (GO/FO) and foreign defense dignitaries.
DoD Regional Sustainment Framework (RSF) Strategy: Directs the establishment of a globally connected, editorially resilient network of regional maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) capabilities with allies and partners.
Demonstrating a deep understanding of, and the ability to apply, Joint Publications, Directives and Instructions with the associated policies that support theater distribution security and vendor threat mitigation.
Example policies/instructions include: DSCA 5105.38-M: Security Assistance Management Manual (SAMM), Title 10, U.S. Code, Chapter 16 (Security Cooperation), Title 10, U.S. Code: Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreements, DoDD 5135.02, Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment, DoDI 5132.03, DoD Policy and Responsibilities Relating to Security Cooperation, DoDI 3000.12, Management of U.S. Global Defense Posture (GDP), DoDI 4000.19, Support Agreements, DoDI 2010.06, Materiel Interoperability and Standardization with Allies and Coalition Partners, JP 4-08, Logistics in Support of Multinational Operations, JP 4-0, Joint Logistics, JP 5-0, Joint Planning.

This position is contingent on award.

Expected salary range: $100,000 - $120,000

Work Environment

Ability to sit at a computer terminal for an extended period of time.
Ability to work in confined areas.

Physical Demands

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to sit, stand, talk, and hear.
Employee is often required to sit and use their hands and fingers to operate a computer.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Travel

11-20% / Occasional travel.

Pursuant to PL 93-638, as amended, preference will be given to qualified Native Americans and spouses in all phases of employment.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree.
Current, active TS/SCI security clearance.
Exceptional written and oral communication with demonstrated experience drafting formal staff packages (action memos, bilateral agreements, background papers) and presenting complex sustainment concepts to senior leadership and international defense officials.

new_jobs.title: Information Security Manager (w/m/d): Delos Cloud
new_jobs.description:
Über Delos Cloud

Delos Cloud wurde von der SAP gegründet, um eine souveräne und sichere Cloud-Plattform für die Digitalisierung des Öffentlichen Diensts in Deutschland bereitzustellen. Unsere Plattform ist hersteller- und lösungsneutral sowie anwendungsoffen. Damit ist sie ein wesentlicher Baustein für die Umsetzung der Deutschen Verwaltungs-Cloud-Strategie (DVS) unter Einhaltung aller relevanten Sicherheits- und Geheimhaltungsvorgaben des BSI. Wir verstehen uns als vertrauensvoller Partner der IT-Dienstleister von Bund, Ländern und Kommunen und ergänzt deren Leistungsportfolio. Weitere Informationen über uns findest du hier: www.deloscloud.de

Die Rolle

Als Information Security Manager (w/m/d) bist du Teil des Delos Cloud Information Security Management System (ISMS) – Teams innerhalb unserer IT-Sicherheit. Als Fachexperte (w/m/d) bist du als Teil des ISMS-Teams verantwortlich für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystems und hilfst du uns dabei, die Einhaltung einer Vielzahl von internen und externen Vorgaben und Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Dabei fungierst du auch als Schnittstelle zu GRC, technischer IT-Sicherheit und allen weiteren Fachbereichen.

Bei uns ist Sicherheit Teil unseres Markenkerns und nicht nur bloße Kostenstelle. Mit deiner Erfahrung schützt du Deutschlands einzige souveräne Azure Cloud und leistest damit einen wertvollen Beitrag zur Digitalisierung unseres Landes.

Wenn du dein Fachwissen einsetzen möchtest, um an vorderster Front mit einem kompetenten Team eine vielschichtige Angriffsfläche zu analysieren und gegen ein breites Spektrum an fortgeschrittenen Angreifern abzusichern, bewirb dich bei uns.

Was Du Tun Wirst

Implementierung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystems (ISMS) u. a. nach ISO/IEC 27001, IT-Grundschutz und BSI C5 im Rahmen unserer Sicherheits-, Zertifizierungs- und Compliancestrategie
Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher und regulatorischer Anforderungen
Erstellung und Überwachung von Informationssicherheitsrichtlinien und -verfahren
Identifikation und Bewertung von Sicherheitsrisiken und Unterstützung der Fachbereiche bei der Umsetzung von Maßnahmen
Vorbereitung von internen und externen Audits
Erstellung von Dokumentation zum Nachweis von Kontrollen im ISMS
Zusammenarbeit mit Fachexperten der Delos Cloud zur Identifikation und Implementierung von Sicherheitsmaßnahmen
Zusammenarbeit mit externen Stakeholdern u.a. aus Bund und Ländern sowie Microsoft und SAP zur Stärkung der Security sowie Compliance Posture der Delos Cloud
Vorbereitung und Übermittlung von Reports und Meldungen an das Senior Management, regulatorische Behörden und weitere Stakeholder

Was Du Mitbringst

Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich Informationssicherheit, idealerweise in einer ähnlichen Position
Erfahrung mit gängigen Standards in der Informationssicherheit, insb. ISO/IEC 27001

Excellent organization and time management skills.

Train and develop staff related to reports, systems and interpretation of data.

Professional Competencies
Prepares time estimates for project activities and develops project schedules, monitors performance and reports progress toward those milestones.
Analyzes information to ensure greater integration of functions within the organization.

Assists in the development of dashboards, budgets and timelines; consistent delivery and performance within established performance parameters.
Highly developed interpersonal skills are required to create behavioral changes in customers and deal with sensitive situations.
Maintaining required regular customer communications and reporting, keeping abreast of developments in patient care areas and tracking all analytical requests.

Creative problem solving under the constraints of overarching management goals

Demonstrated excellent analytical skills
Excellent PC-based skills using Microsoft Products (Excel, etc.) and computer knowledge base
Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred:

Master’s Degree
Previous experience in healthcare analytics and finance

Clear, professional communication and attention to detail

Distribution across 2,200+ counterparties, with coverage and electronic trading infrastructure already built

About The Company

Moody's Corporation is a renowned global leader in credit ratings, research, and risk analysis. With a rich history of providing independent and insightful assessments of creditworthiness, Moody's helps organizations, investors, and governments make informed decisions in an increasingly complex financial landscape. The company is committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives and innovative thinking. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, including artificial intelligence and data analytics, Moody's transforms risk assessment into actionable insights, enabling clients to navigate uncertainty with confidence. The organization prides itself on its integrity, professionalism, and dedication to delivering high-quality services that support sustainable economic growth worldwide.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Data Analyst to join Moody's Data Management and Analytics team within the Customer Operations and Risk organization. This role is pivotal in designing and delivering trusted analytics, data products, and AI-enabled solutions that support critical business functions across the enterprise. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Business Intelligence, Financial Planning and Analysis, and Sales Analytics—to gather requirements, develop data models, and implement innovative solutions that enhance decision-making processes. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of data, technology, and business strategy, contributing to Moody's mission of transforming risk into opportunity. The role requires a strategic thinker with strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and a passion for leveraging data to solve complex business challenges.

Qualifications

A minimum of 10 years of experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and stakeholder management within business intelligence, analytics, or data product delivery, preferably supporting finance, revenue, lead-to-cash, or enterprise reporting environments.
Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and testable acceptance criteria.
Strong collaboration skills across business and technology teams, with the ability to influence design decisions and propose practical, business-aligned solutions.
Experience designing business-aligned data products, semantic models, reporting frameworks, and reusable analytics solutions in partnership with engineering teams.
Knowledge of data modeling, Lakehouse, and data warehousing concepts, including dimensional modeling, semantic layers, data quality, lineage, and governance.
Hands-on experience with analytics platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Power BI, or comparable tools; familiarity with CRM and source systems like Salesforce is preferred.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to validate data, challenge assumptions, and ensure reporting accuracy and usability.
Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts with practical experience in implementing AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. A growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to ethical AI use are essential.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Responsibilities

The Business Data Analyst will partner with various business and technology teams to design, develop, and implement trusted analytics, reporting, and data products, including AI-enabled solutions that drive business value.

Collaborate with stakeholders from Business Intelligence, Financial Planning and Analysis, Sales Planning, and Analytics teams to elicit, clarify, and prioritize reporting and data requirements.
Translate complex business problems into clear user stories, detailed business requirements, data definitions, and acceptance criteria to guide development efforts.
Evaluate and recommend architectural approaches across platforms such as Databricks, reporting layers, and analytical workflows, ensuring alignment with business needs and technical standards.
Facilitate workshops and working sessions with diverse stakeholders, managing expectations, scope, and trade-offs to ensure successful delivery.
Support data modeling activities, including defining dimensions, measures, hierarchies, and lineage, aligned with business semantics.
Contribute to the design of reporting solutions, source-to-target mappings, semantic layers, reusable data assets, and consumption patterns to optimize analytics efficiency.
Lead or support comprehensive testing of reports, datasets, and analytical outputs, validating results against source systems and business rules to ensure accuracy.
Ensure all solutions adhere to data quality, governance, usability standards, and identify opportunities for AI-driven automation and insights to enhance decision-making processes.

This includes comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, along with parental leave and paid time off to promote work-life balance. Employees are also eligible for a 401(k) plan with company matching contributions, life, disability, and accident insurance to provide financial security. Moody's supports continuous learning through tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities. new_jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
¿Te gustaría convertir datos en decisiones que tengan un impacto real en el negocio?

En LIDERING
buscamos incorporar un/a Business Operations Analyst
con una combinación de visión de negocio, capacidad analítica y curiosidad por entender cómo funcionan las cosas.

No buscamos únicamente a alguien que construya dashboards o prepare informes. Queremos una persona que quiera ir un paso más allá: entender qué está ocurriendo en el negocio, por qué está ocurriendo y qué podemos hacer para mejorar.
Cuestionar constructivamente el "siempre lo hemos hecho así" y buscar maneras más eficientes de hacer las cosas. Que no se quede únicamente en el diagnóstico, sino que busca convertir sus análisis en decisiones y mejoras reales
.

Trabajarás de forma transversal con diferentes departamentos, analizando información financiera, comercial y operativa, entendiendo sus procesos e identificando oportunidades que nos ayuden a trabajar mejor y tomar mejores decisiones.

Si disfrutas convirtiendo preguntas de negocio en análisis, y análisis en decisiones
, queremos conocerte.

Misión

Impulsar la mejora del negocio a través del análisis de datos, la comprensión de los procesos y la identificación de oportunidades que permitan tomar mejores decisiones.

Tendrás una visión transversal de la compañía y trabajarás junto a las diferentes áreas para comprender cómo funciona el negocio, analizar sus resultados y transformar datos financieros, comerciales y operativos en insights, recomendaciones y acciones concretas.

Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, iniciativa y visión de negocio, capaz de combinar una mentalidad analítica con una clara orientación a resultados y mejora continua.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?

Analizar la evolución del negocio a través de datos de ventas, márgenes, rentabilidad, clientes, productos, compras y otros indicadores relevantes, identificando tendencias, desviaciones y oportunidades.
Transformar datos en insights y recomendaciones de negocio, ayudando a comprender qué hay detrás de los resultados y qué decisiones pueden contribuir a mejorarlos.
Trabajar de forma transversal con Ventas, Compras, Producción, Ingeniería y Finanzas, comprendiendo sus procesos y necesidades para identificar oportunidades de mejora y evaluar su impacto en el negocio.
Realizar análisis ad hoc y business cases para evaluar oportunidades, problemáticas o iniciativas desde una perspectiva económica y de negocio.
Definir y monitorizar KPIs de negocio y performance junto con los responsables de las diferentes áreas.
Diseñar, desarrollar y evolucionar dashboards y cuadros de mando en Power BI, convirtiendo la información disponible en herramientas útiles para la gestión y la toma de decisiones.
Identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos, utilizando los datos y el conocimiento del negocio para detectar ineficiencias, cuellos de botella y nuevas formas de trabajar.
Participar en proyectos transversales de mejora y transformación, aportando análisis, estructura y seguimiento de resultados.
Actuar como nexo entre las áreas de negocio, Finanzas e IT, traduciendo necesidades de negocio en requerimientos analíticos y contribuyendo al desarrollo de soluciones que aporten valor a los usuarios.
Contribuir a garantizar la calidad, coherencia y fiabilidad de la información, participando en la mejora del dato maestro y de las fuentes utilizadas para el análisis.
Impulsar una cultura cada vez más Data-Driven, ayudando a los equipos a interpretar la información y utilizar los datos como una herramienta habitual para tomar decisiones.
Colaborar con el equipo y participar en otras iniciativas relacionadas con la posición que contribuyan a los objetivos del negocio.
Aplicar los criterios y procedimientos ambientales definidos por la organización en el desarrollo de tus funciones.

¿Qué buscamos?

Más allá de la experiencia y los conocimientos técnicos, buscamos una persona con curiosidad por el negocio
.

Alguien que no se conforme con detectar que las ventas o el margen han cambiado, sino que quiera entender por qué
, hablar con las personas involucradas, analizar la información y conectar los puntos hasta llegar a una conclusión.

Nos gustaría que aportaras:

Formación universitaria en ADE, Economía, Finanzas, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística o similar. También valoraremos otras formaciones que aporten una buena combinación de capacidad analítica y orientación a negocio.
Aproximadamente 2-4 años de experiencia en posiciones relacionadas con Business Analytics, Business Operations, Control de Gestión, FP&A, Business Intelligence o análisis de negocio.
Buena visión económica y de negocio, con capacidad para interpretar indicadores de ventas, margen, rentabilidad, costes y evolución frente a objetivos.
Dominio avanzado de Microsoft Excel y experiencia trabajando con herramientas de Business Intelligence, preferentemente Power BI.
Se valorarán conocimientos de SQL y bases de datos relacionales.
Capacidad para entender cómo funcionan los procesos de diferentes áreas y relacionar la operativa del día a día con su impacto en los resultados.
Capacidad para interpretar los datos, cuestionarlos y convertirlos en conclusiones y recomendaciones accionables.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para relacionarte con perfiles muy diferentes, tanto técnicos como de negocio.
Inglés medio-alto, equivalente aproximadamente a B2/C1.

Será un plus si además tienes...

Experiencia con Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación/migración de ERP.
Experiencia en entornos industriales, distribución o B2B.
Experiencia en proyectos de mejora de procesos.

¿Cómo imaginamos a la persona que encajará especialmente bien?

Buscamos una persona:

🔎 Curiosa:
quiere entender qué hay detrás de los números.

📊 Analítica:
se siente cómoda trabajando con datos, pero sabe que el dato es un medio y no un fin.

💡 Proactiva:
identifica oportunidades y propone, sin limitarse a esperar una petición.

🤝 Transversal:
disfruta hablando con diferentes departamentos y entendiendo cómo funcionan.

💼 Con visión de negocio:
conecta decisiones operativas con ventas, margen, rentabilidad y resultados.

🚀 Con mentalidad de mejora:
cuestiona constructivamente el "siempre lo hemos hecho así" y busca maneras más eficientes de hacer las cosas.

🎯 Orientada a la acción:
no se queda únicamente en el diagnóstico, sino que busca convertir sus análisis en decisiones y mejoras reales.

No te encontrarás con un departamento de Business Analytics en Lidering, serás la única persona dentro de esta empresa con este rol y tendrás camino por delante por hacer, pero contarás con el apoyo no sólo de la empresa, sino también del grupo.

¿Por qué este puesto es diferente?

Porque no es una posición puramente de Data ni puramente de Finanzas
.

Los datos serán una de tus principales herramientas, pero tu objetivo será entender y mejorar el negocio
.

Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con diferentes áreas, conocer de cerca cómo funcionan sus procesos y convertir toda esa información en análisis y recomendaciones que puedan tener un impacto directo en la toma de decisiones.

Si eres de esas personas que cuando ve un dato piensa inmediatamente "¿por qué?"
y después "¿qué podemos hacer con esto?"
, probablemente nos entendamos bien.

Más sobre Lidering

Lidering
forma parte del Grupo EPI INDUSTRIES family of companies, con una trayectoria de más de 70 años en el mercado y con la misión de ofrecer productos y soluciones técnicas de calidad a nuestro cliente industrial, dentro de una amplia gama.

es la empresa especializada en sellos mecánicos. Tiene más de 50 años en el mercado como expertos en sellos mecánicos y soluciones para la industria del bombeo y trasiego de fluidos.

En nuestras instalaciones de Lidering Cornellà

Explora más en: https://www.lidering.com/

About The Company

CBRE Group, Inc. is a global leader in commercial real estate services and investment, renowned for its extensive reach and comprehensive service offerings. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, CBRE is a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company with a diverse workforce of over 140,000 employees worldwide. Operating in more than 100 countries, CBRE provides a wide array of services, including advisory, building operations and experience, project management, and real estate investments. The company's mission is to create value for clients by delivering innovative solutions and fostering sustainable growth. CBRE's core values emphasize respect, integrity, service, and excellence, which underpin its collaborative culture and commitment to diversity and inclusion. The organization continually strives to attract talented professionals who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact in the real estate industry.

About The Role

The Senior Data Analyst at CBRE plays a pivotal role within the Data Science & Analytics team, responsible for performing comprehensive data analyses to support strategic decision-making and business growth. This position involves reviewing and interpreting complex data sets related to global real estate markets and asset operations, ensuring that insights and recommendations are grounded in thorough research and accurate findings. The Senior Data Analyst will coordinate data aggregation efforts, develop and maintain data pipelines, and curate sophisticated reports using various business intelligence tools. They will also perform ad-hoc analyses, define intricate data requirements, and utilize programming languages and open-source tools to extract valuable insights. The role requires a keen eye for detail, strong judgment, and the ability to communicate complex data stories clearly across different organizational levels. Collaborating with agile development teams, the analyst will contribute to enhancing existing processes and developing new strategies to optimize data usage and improve business performance.

Key responsibilities include developing data structures, standardizing information, confirming data quality, and applying modeling techniques to identify opportunities for strategic improvements. The Senior Data Analyst will also lead efforts in creating detailed reports, presenting findings effectively, and supporting the organization in leveraging data-driven insights to achieve operational excellence. This role demands a combination of technical expertise, analytical thinking, and strong communication skills, all within a structured environment that values accuracy, integrity, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor's degree, preferably with 2-5 years of relevant experience in data analysis or related fields. A combination of education and practical experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. A Master’s degree is preferred. Candidates should have a solid understanding of standard procedures and techniques to solve moderately complex problems, along with the ability to apply technical knowledge and judgment effectively. Proficiency in Microsoft Office products, especially Word, Excel, and Outlook, is essential. Strong organizational skills, an inquisitive mindset, and the ability to understand and interpret complex data are critical for success in this role. Familiarity with programming languages, open-source evaluation tools, and data modeling techniques will be advantageous. The candidate should demonstrate excellent communication skills, capable of explaining complex insights in straightforward terms, and possess a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for data utilization and process improvements.

Responsibilities

Coordinate data aggregation and curate detailed reports utilizing various business intelligence and reporting platforms to support strategic initiatives. Perform ad-hoc and strategic reviews of structured and unstructured data, reflecting insights into global real estate markets and asset management operations. Develop and maintain data pipelines, ensuring data is organized, cleansed, and standardized to facilitate accurate analysis and reporting. Define complex data requirements, gather relevant information, and apply statistical tests to validate findings. Use programming tools and open-source software to plan models, analyze data, and extract actionable insights. Identify opportunities to maximize data utilization by applying modeling, optimization, and analytical techniques to develop innovative strategies that enhance business performance. Create ad-hoc reports based on ongoing reviews of existing data sources, providing timely insights to stakeholders. Ensure the quality and integrity of all data sources, confirming accuracy and consistency. Collaborate closely with agile development teams to recommend process enhancements, streamline data workflows, and improve reporting capabilities. Apply standard principles and techniques to solve routine and slightly complex problems, working within established guidelines and policies. Lead by example, demonstrating professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to CBRE’s core values. Effectively communicate complex data findings to diverse audiences, including non-technical stakeholders, ensuring clarity and understanding. Manage multiple priorities efficiently, meeting deadlines and maintaining high standards of work quality.

Benefits

CBRE offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' health, well-being, and financial security. Successful candidates will be eligible for a 401(k) retirement plan, dental, health, life, and vision insurance. The company also provides various wellness programs, paid time off, and opportunities for professional development. Employees can benefit from a competitive salary range, discretionary bonuses, and a collaborative work environment that encourages growth and innovation. CBRE is committed to fostering a positive workplace culture that values diversity, inclusion, and respect, ensuring all employees feel valued and empowered to contribute their best. Additionally, the company supports work-life balance through flexible work arrangements and ongoing learning opportunities to help employees advance their careers within a dynamic global organization.

new_jobs.description:
Capital One, a Fortune 500 company and one of the nation’s top 10 banks, offers a broad spectrum of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared Values, come together to make Capital One a great company – and a great place to work.

We are looking for a forward-thinking, dynamic, and insightful Manager to join our Finance Integrated Program & Delivery (FIPD) team. In this role, you will lead high-impact strategic initiatives that are transforming how we work in Finance. You will serve as a central point of orchestration for a portfolio of high priority, complex initiatives across the Finance organization. This role will bring structure, discipline and a holistic Finance perspective to work that spans across multiple teams, stakeholders, and priorities – ensuring leaders have clear visibility into what is happening, where decisions are required, and what could impact successful delivery.

In addition to managing Finance initiatives, this role will help accelerate AI adoption within our team by developing a strong understanding of existing processes and ways of working, identifying opportunities where AI can create meaningful value, and helping translate those opportunities into actionable use cases.

A successful candidate will operate as more than a project manager. They will be expected to understand the broader business context, anticipate what is needed next, challenge teams when appropriate, and translate complex information into clear recommendations and actions for senior leadership.

General Responsibilities:

Executive Visibility: Develop concise decision-oriented updates that provide senior leaders with a clear understanding of progress, emerging issues, key decisions, and areas requiring leadership intervention
Strategic Communications: Own and drive clear, consistent, and timely communications across the portfolio, translating complex program information into audience-appropriate messaging for executives, stakeholders and delivery teams; ensure key decisions, priorities, risks, and changes are communicated effectively and drive shared understanding and action
Cross-Program Connectivity: Identify connections, overlaps, competing priorities, and opportunities across initiatives to ensure work is managed through enterprise lens
Proactive Risk and Dependency Management: Identify risks, dependencies, capacity constraints and potential delivery challenges early; drive mitigation plans and escalate issues before they impact critical outcomes
Decision Management: Establish clear mechanisms for capturing decisions, identifying decision owners, defining required inputs and ensuring decisions are made at the appropriate level and translated into action
Strategic Planning: Translate strategic priorities into executable plans, helping teams move from broad objectives to defined outcomes, workstreams, milestones and measurable success criteria
Forward-Looking Insights: Looking beyond current milestones to anticipate upcoming needs, decisions, risks, and organizational impacts, helping leadership stay multiple steps ahead
AI Opportunity Identification & Adoption: Develop a strong understanding of the team’s current processes and workflows to proactively identify opportunities where AI can simplify work, automate manual activities, improve insights or enhance how the team operates; partner with team members to evaluate, prioritize, and advance high-value opportunities from idea through implementation
Reporting & Analytics: Provide critical visibility into the AI portfolio. Utilize standardized reporting to track adoption, resource demand, and project health, replacing manual/bespoke reporting with self-service tools.
Continuous Improvement: Evaluate how work is managed today and introduce new tools, AI capabilities, automation, and operating practices that make program delivery faster, simpler, and more effective

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience
At least 5 years of Project Management or Program Management experience, including experience leading business transformation projects

Preferred Qualifications:

Masters / MBA degree
Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies in a technical or data-driven environment
SAFe certification
Experience with AI or GenAI-enabled projects, including familiarity with risk governance or AI model lifecycle management
Strong familiarity with Finance/Accounting operations and the challenges of legacy data ecosystems
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive consensus across disparate teams (e.g., Business, Tech, Risk, Data)
